    private static void ShowMenuListMob()
	{
        MyVector myVector = new MyVector();
        List<Mob> list = new List<Mob>();
        for (int i = 0; i < GameScr.vMob.size(); i++)
        {
            Mob mob = (Mob)GameScr.vMob.elementAt(i);
            if (mob.isMobMe)
            {
                continue;
            }
            bool flag = false;
            for (int j = 0; j < list.Count; j++)
            {
                if (mob.templateId == list[j].templateId)
                {
                    flag = true;
                    break;
                }
            }
            if (!flag)
            {
                list.Add(mob);
                myVector.addElement(new Command("Tàn Sát\n" + mob.getTemplate().name + "\n[" + NinjaUtil.getMoneys(mob.maxHp) + "HP]", getInstance(), 1, mob.templateId));
            }
        }
        GameCanvas.menu.startAt(myVector, 3);
    }
	private static void ShowMenuGoback()
	{
		MyVector myVector = new MyVector();
		myVector.addElement(new Command("Goback\n" + (isGoBack ? ("[" + TileMap.mapNames[gobackMapID] + "]\n[" + gobackZoneID + "]") : "[OFF]"), getInstance(), 9, null));
		myVector.addElement(new Command("Goback Tọa Độ\n" + ((!isGoBack || !isGobackCoordinate) ? "[OFF]" : ("[" + gobackX + "-" + gobackY + "]")), getInstance(), 10, null));
		myVector.addElement(new Command("Về Nhà Khi MP Dưới\n[" + minimumMPGoHome + "%]", getInstance(), 11, null));
		GameCanvas.menu.startAt(myVector, 3);
	}

    private static void TeleportTo(int x, int y)
	{
        if (Char.myCharz().isLockMove && Char.myCharz().npcFocus == null)
        {
            GameScr.info1.addInfo("Đang không thể di chuyển!", 0);
            return;
        }
        Char.myCharz().cx = x;
		Char.myCharz().cy = y;
		Service.gI().charMove();
		if (ItemTime.isExistItem(4387))return;
        Char.myCharz().cx = x;
		Char.myCharz().cy = y + 1;
		Service.gI().charMove();
		Char.myCharz().cx = x;
		Char.myCharz().cy = y;
		Service.gI().charMove();
	}

	private static bool isMeAvoidAttack(Mob mob)
	{
		//if (!GameScr.canAutoPlay)
		//{
		if (mob.checkIsBoss()) return isAvoidSuperMob;
		else return isAvoidUnCommonMob;
		//}
		return false;
	}

	private static bool isMeOutOfMPorHP()
	{
		return (Char.myCharz().cMP < Char.myCharz().cMPFull * minimumMPGoHome / 100)||(Char.myCharz().cHP < Char.myCharz().cHPFull * minimumHPGoHome / 100);
	}
    private static bool IsValidMob(Mob mob)
    {
        var type = MainMod.CurrentSetting.IsTrainMobHP;
        long limitHP = MainMod.CurrentSetting.TrainMobHP;

        return type switch
        {
            AccountSetting.TypeHPMob.All => true,
            AccountSetting.TypeHPMob.Less => mob.hp <= limitHP,
            AccountSetting.TypeHPMob.More => mob.hp >= limitHP,
            _ => false,
        };
    }
    private static int TypeTrainMob()
    {
        var type = MainMod.CurrentSetting.TrainMobType;

        return type switch
        {
            AccountSetting.TypeMob.All => 0,
            AccountSetting.TypeMob.Index => 1,
            AccountSetting.TypeMob.Template_id => 2,
            _ => 0,
        };
    }
	private static bool GetMobTemplateId(Mob mob)
	{
		for (int i = 0; i < MainMod.CurrentSetting.ListMob.Length; i++)
		{
			if (mob.templateId == MainMod.CurrentSetting.ListMob[i])
			{
				return true;
			}
		}
		return false;
    }
	private static Mob GetNextMob()
	{
		try
		{
			int type = TypeTrainMob();
			Mob result = null;
			if (type == 0)
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < GameScr.vMob.size(); i++)
				{
					Mob mob = (Mob)GameScr.vMob.elementAt(i);
					if (mob != null)
					{
						if (!mob.isMobMe && mob.status != 0 && mob.status != 1 && IsValidMob(mob) && !isMeAvoidAttack(mob))
						{
							result = mob;
							break;
						}
					}
				}
				return result;
			}
			else if (type == 1)
			{
				Mob result1 = null;
				for (int i = 0; i < MainMod.CurrentSetting.ListMob.Length; i++)
				{
					Mob mob1 = (Mob)GameScr.vMob.elementAt(MainMod.CurrentSetting.ListMob[i]);
					if (mob1 != null)
					{
						if (mob1.status != 0 && mob1.status != 1 && mob1.hp > 0 && !mob1.isMobMe && IsValidMob(mob1) && !isMeAvoidAttack(mob1))
						{
							result1 = mob1;
							break;
						}
					}
				}
				return result1;
			}
			Mob result2 = null;
			int num2 = 9999;
			for (int j = 0; j < GameScr.vMob.size(); j++)
			{
				Mob mob2 = (Mob)GameScr.vMob.elementAt(j);
				if (mob2 != null)
				{
					if (mob2.status != 0 && mob2.status != 1 && mob2.hp > 0 && !mob2.isMobMe && GetMobTemplateId(mob2) && !isMeAvoidAttack(mob2))
					{
						int num3 = Math.abs(Char.myCharz().cx - mob2.x);
						if (num2 > num3 && IsValidMob(mob2))
						{
							result2 = mob2;
							num2 = num3;
						}
					}
				}
			}
			return result2;
		}
		catch (Exception ex)
		{
			//Console.WriteLine("Lỗi GetNextMob: " + ex.Message +"\n" + ex.StackTrace);
            return null;
		}
	}

	private static void DoIt()
	{
		if (MainMod.CurrentSetting.IsUseTDLT && !ItemTime.isExistItem(4387)) return;
        //if (Char.myCharz().meDead || Char.myCharz().cHP <= 0) return;
        //if ((!isAutoTrain && !GameScr.canAutoPlay) || GameScr.isChangeZone || Char.myCharz().statusMe == 14 || Char.myCharz().statusMe == 5 || Char.myCharz().isCharge || Char.myCharz().isFlyAndCharge || Char.myCharz().isUseChargeSkill())
        //{
        //	return;
        //}
        //if (listMobIds.Count == 0)
        //{
        //	GameScr.info1.addInfo("Danh Sách Tàn Sát Trống!", 0);
        //	return;
        //}
        if (Char.myCharz().mobFocus == null || (Char.myCharz().mobFocus != null && Char.myCharz().mobFocus.isMobMe))
		{
			if (!GameScr.canAutoPlay)
			{
				if (AutoPick.isAutoPick)
				{
					AutoPick.FocusToNearestItem();
					if (Char.myCharz().itemFocus != null)
					{
						AutoPick.PickIt();
					}
				}
			}
			else Char.myCharz().itemFocus = null;
			if (Char.myCharz().itemFocus == null)
			{
				Mob nextMob = GetNextMob();
				if (nextMob != null)
				{
					Char.myCharz().currentMovePoint = null;
                    Char.myCharz().mobFocus = nextMob;
				}
			}
		}
		else
		{
			if (Char.myCharz().mobFocus.hp <= 0 || Char.myCharz().mobFocus.status == 1 || Char.myCharz().mobFocus.status == 0 || !IsValidMob(Char.myCharz().mobFocus)) Char.myCharz().mobFocus = null;
		}
		if (Char.myCharz().mobFocus == null || (Char.myCharz().skillInfoPaint() != null && Char.myCharz().indexSkill < Char.myCharz().skillInfoPaint().Length && Char.myCharz().dart != null && Char.myCharz().arr != null))
		{
			return;
		}
		Skill skill = null;
		//var allowedIds = new HashSet<int>(MainMod.CurrentSetting.ListSkill.Select(id));
		int[] allowedIds = MainMod.CurrentSetting.ListSkill;
        foreach (var s in GameScr.keySkill)
		{
			if (s == null || !allowedIds.Contains(s.template.id))
				continue;
			if (s.paintCanNotUseSkill)
				continue;
			if (Char.myCharz().skillInfoPaint() != null)
				continue;
			int manaCost = (s.template.manaUseType == 2)
				? 1
				: (s.template.manaUseType == 1
				? (int)(s.manaUse * Char.myCharz().cMPFull / 100)
				: s.manaUse);
			if (Char.myCharz().cMP < manaCost)
				continue;

			if (skill == null || skill.coolDown < s.coolDown)
				skill = s;
			if (skill != null)
			{
				if (skill.template.id == 13 && Char.myCharz().isMonkey == 1)
				{
					skill = null;
					continue;
                }
				if(skill.template.id == 9 && Char.myCharz().cHP * 10 <= Char.myCharz().cHPFull)
				{
                    foreach (var s2 in GameScr.keySkill)
					{
						if (s2.template.id == 0) skill = s2;
					}
                }
            }
		}
		if (skill != null)
		{
			if ((skill.template.id >= 0 && skill.template.id <= 5) || skill.template.id == 7 || skill.template.id == 9 || skill.template.id == 17)
			{
				if (global::Char.myCharz().myskill != skill)
				{
					GameScr.gI().doSelectSkill(skill, true);
				}
			}
			else GameScr.gI().doSelectSkill(skill, true);
            bool canUseSkillAttack = (!ItemTime.isExistItem(4387) && (double)Math.abs(Char.myCharz().mobFocus.x - Char.myCharz().cx) < (double)skill.dx * 1.7) || ItemTime.isExistItem(4387);
			if (skill.template.type >= 3 || skill.template.id == 10 || skill.template.id == 11 || skill.template.id == 14 || !canUseSkillAttack || (skill.paintCanNotUseSkill && !GameCanvas.panel.isShow))
			{
				return;
			}
			if (mSystem.currentTimeMillis() - skill.lastTimeUseThisSkill > skill.coolDown + 100L)
			{
				if (skill.template.id == 7)
				{
                    skill.lastTimeUseThisSkill = mSystem.currentTimeMillis();
                    MyVector myVector = new MyVector();
                    myVector.addElement(Char.myCharz());
                    Service.gI().sendPlayerAttack(new MyVector(),myVector, 1);
					return;
                }
				if (GameScr.gI().isMeCanAttackMob(Char.myCharz().mobFocus))
				{
					skill.lastTimeUseThisSkill = mSystem.currentTimeMillis();
					MyVector myVector = new MyVector();
					myVector.addElement(Char.myCharz().mobFocus);
					Service.gI().sendPlayerAttack(myVector, new MyVector(), 1);
				}
			}
		}
    }

	public static void UseGrape()

		for (int i = 0; i < Char.myCharz().arrItemBag.Length; i++)

			Item item = Char.myCharz().arrItemBag[i];
			if (item != null && item.template.id == 212)

		for (int j = 0; j < Char.myCharz().arrItemBag.Length; j++)
		{
			Item item2 = Char.myCharz().arrItemBag[j];
			if (item2 != null && item2.template.id == 211)

				Service.gI().useItem(0, 1, (sbyte)item2.indexUI, -1);
				break;
			}
		}
	}

	public static void kok()
	{
		if (Char.myCharz().meDead)
		{
			long_101 = mSystem.currentTimeMillis();
			return;
		}
		if (mSystem.currentTimeMillis() - long_101 >= 400L)
		{
            if (Char.myCharz().isLockMove|| Char.myCharz().isWaitMonkey|| Char.myCharz().isStandAndCharge|| Char.myCharz().holder) return;
            if (IsKok)
			{
				chongmkn = false;
                long_101 = mSystem.currentTimeMillis();
                if (Char.myCharz().cx != gobackX)
                {
                    Char.myCharz().cx = gobackX;
                    Service.gI().charMove();
                }
                else
                {
                    Char.myCharz().cx = gobackX - 10;
                    Service.gI().charMove();
                }
            }
            if (chongmkn)
            {
                IsKok = false;
                long_101 = mSystem.currentTimeMillis()+3000L;
                Char.myCharz().cx -= 10;
                Service.gI().charMove();
                Char.myCharz().cx += 10;
                Service.gI().charMove();
            }
		}
	}

    public static bool isTileTypeMap(int cx, int cy)
    {
        return TileMap.tileTypeAt(cx * 24, cy * 24, 4) || TileMap.tileTypeAt(cx * 24, cy * 24, 8) || TileMap.tileTypeAt(cx * 24, (cy - 1) * 24, 2) || TileMap.tileTypeAt(cx * 24, (cy - 1) * 24, 8192);
    }

    public static void ChayBo(int cxmob, int cymob)
	{
		int cx = Char.myCharz().cx;
		int cy = Char.myCharz().cy;
		if (cxmob != lastMobX || cymob != lastMobY || Way == null)
		{
			Way = FindPath(cx, cy, cxmob, cymob);
			currentStep = 0;
			lastMobX = cxmob;
			lastMobY = cymob;
			if (Way.Length <= 0 || Way == null)
			{
				//Console.WriteLine("path null");
				currentStep = 0;
				return;
			}
		}
		if (Char.myCharz().cx == Way[Way.Length - 1].X && Char.myCharz().cy == Way[Way.Length - 1].Y)
		{
			currentStep = 0;
			Way = null;
			return;
		}
		if (mSystem.currentTimeMillis() - TrainLoad > 50L)
		{
			TrainLoad = mSystem.currentTimeMillis();
			if (currentStep < Way.Length)
			{
				Move(Way[currentStep].X, Way[currentStep].Y);
				currentStep++;
				return;
			}
			currentStep = Way.Length - 1;
			Way = null;
		}
	}
}

    public static void Anattack()
    {
        if (Char.myCharz().mobFocus == null && global::Char.myCharz().charFocus == null)
        {
            GameScr.info1.addInfo("Chưa chỉ định mục tiêu!", 0);
            return;
        }
        if (Char.myCharz().mobFocus != null && global::Char.myCharz().charFocus != null)
        {
            GameScr.info1.addInfo("Lỗi! Đang chỉ định 2 mục tiêu!", 0);
            return;
        }
        if (!ItemTime.isExistItem(4387))
        {
            GameScr.info1.addInfo("Khuyến khích bật tdlt", 0);
        }
        if (Char.myCharz().mobFocus != null)
        {
            if (mSystem.currentTimeMillis() - Delaypem > AutoSkill.GetCoolDown(Char.myCharz().myskill))
            {
                Delaypem = mSystem.currentTimeMillis();
                if (!ItemTime.isExistItem(4387))
                {
                    global::Char.myCharz().cx = Char.myCharz().mobFocus.x;
                    Service.gI().charMove();
                    global::Char.myCharz().cx = Char.myCharz().mobFocus.x - 1;
                    Service.gI().charMove();
                }
                MyVector myVector = new MyVector();
                myVector.addElement(global::Char.myCharz().mobFocus);
                Service.gI().sendPlayerAttack(myVector, new MyVector(), -1);
            }
        }
        if (Char.myCharz().charFocus != null)
        {
            if (mSystem.currentTimeMillis() - islastTele < 500L)
            {
                return;
            }
            islastTele = mSystem.currentTimeMillis();
            global::Char.myCharz().cx = global::Char.myCharz().charFocus.cx;
            global::Char.myCharz().cy = global::Char.myCharz().charFocus.cy;
            Service.gI().charMove();
            if (!ItemTime.isExistItem(4387))
            {
                global::Char.myCharz().cx = global::Char.myCharz().charFocus.cx;
                global::Char.myCharz().cy = global::Char.myCharz().charFocus.cy + 1;
                Service.gI().charMove();
                global::Char.myCharz().cx = global::Char.myCharz().charFocus.cx;
                global::Char.myCharz().cy = global::Char.myCharz().charFocus.cy;
                Service.gI().charMove();
            }

            Service.gI().sendPlayerAttack(new MyVector(), myVector, -1);
        }

    private static void WriteDataTS(string Path, List<string> text)
    {
        string includeFile = "";
        File.AppendAllText(Path, string.Empty); // Clear the file before writing
        for (int i = 0; i < text.Count; i++)
        {
            includeFile = includeFile + text[i] + ",";
        }
        File.WriteAllText(Path, includeFile);
    }
    private static void LoadDataTS(string Path, List<string> text)
    {
        string[] InPath = File.ReadAllText(Path).Split(',');
        for (int i = 0; i < InPath.Length; i++)
        {
            text.Add(InPath[i]);
        }
    }

                try
                {
                    string kihieu = ChatTextField.gI().tfChat.getText().ToUpper();
                    kihieuclanExclude.Add(kihieu);
                    WriteDataTS("Data\\Symbol_Exclude.ini", kihieuclanExclude);
                    GameScr.info1.addInfo("Đã Thêm: " + kihieu, 0);
                }
                catch (Exception ex)
                {
                    GameScr.info1.addInfo("Kí Hiệu Clan Không Hợp Lệ, Vui Lòng Nhập Lại", 0);

                }
                ResetChatTextField();
            }
            else if (ChatTextField.gI().strChat.Equals(inputHPBossMobAttack[0]))
            {
                try
                {
                    int num2 = (HPattack = int.Parse(ChatTextField.gI().tfChat.getText()));
                    GameScr.info1.addInfo("Tấn công mục tiêu HP Dưới: " + Res.formatNumber2(num2), 0);
                }
                catch
                {
                    GameScr.info1.addInfo("HP Không Hợp Lệ, Vui Lòng Nhập Lại!", 0);
                }
                ResetChatTextField();
            }
            else if (ChatTextField.gI().strChat.Equals(inputHPChar[0]))
            {
                try
                {
                    int num2 = (limitHPChar = int.Parse(ChatTextField.gI().tfChat.getText()));
                }
                catch
                {
                    GameScr.info1.addInfo("HP Không Hợp Lệ, Vui Lòng Nhập Lại!", 0);
                }
                ResetChatTextField();
            }
        }
		else
		{
			ChatTextField.gI().isShow = false;
		}
	}

	public void perform(int idAction, object p)
	{
		switch (idAction)
		{
		case 1:
			isAutoSendAttack = !isAutoSendAttack;
			GameScr.info1.addInfo("Tự Đánh\n" + (isAutoSendAttack ? "[ON]" : "[OFF]"), 0);
			if (isAutoSendAttack)
			{
				isAutoChangeFocus = false;
			}
			break;
		case 2:
			isTrainPet = !isTrainPet;
			GameScr.info1.addInfo("Đánh Khi Đệ Cần\n" + (isTrainPet ? "[ON]" : "[OFF]"), 0);
			break;
		case 3:
		{
			MyVector myVector = new MyVector();
			myVector.addElement(new Command("Lưu skill\n"+(isSaveSkill ? "hiện tại" : "mặc định"), getInstance(), 5, null));
            for (int i = 0; i < GameScr.keySkill.Length; i++)
			{
				myVector.addElement(new Command(((GameScr.keySkill[i] != null) ? GameScr.keySkill[i].template.name : "null") + "\n[" + (i + 1) + "]\n", getInstance(), 10, i));
			}
			GameCanvas.menu.startAt(myVector, 3);
			break;
		}
		case 4:
			isAutoShield = !isAutoShield;
			GameScr.info1.addInfo("Auto Khiên Pro\n" + (isAutoShield ? "[ON]" : "[OFF]"), 0);
			break;
		case 5:
			isSaveSkill = !isSaveSkill;
            Rms.saveRMSInt("AutoSaveSkill", isSaveSkill ? 1 : 0);
            break;
		case 6:
			isAutoChangeFocus = !isAutoChangeFocus;
			GameScr.info1.addInfo("Đánh Chuyển Mục Tiêu\n" + (isAutoChangeFocus ? "[ON]" : "[OFF]"), 0);
			if (isAutoChangeFocus)
			{
				isAutoSendAttack = false;
			}
			break;
		case 7:
			listTargetAutoChangeFocus.Clear();
			GameScr.info1.addInfo("Đã Xóa Danh Sách Đánh Chuyển Mục Tiêu!", 0);
			break;
		case 8:
			if (Char.myCharz().charFocus != null)
			{
				listTargetAutoChangeFocus.Remove(Char.myCharz().charFocus);
				GameScr.info1.addInfo("Đã Xóa " + Char.myCharz().charFocus.cName + " [" + Char.myCharz().charFocus.charID + "]", 0);
			}
			break;
		case 9:
			if (Char.myCharz().charFocus != null)
			{
				listTargetAutoChangeFocus.Add(Char.myCharz().charFocus);
				GameScr.info1.addInfo("Đã Thêm " + Char.myCharz().charFocus.cName + " [" + Char.myCharz().charFocus.charID + "]", 0);
			}
			break;
		case 10:
			ShowMenuAutoSkill((int)p);
			break;
		case 11:
		{
			int num2 = (int)p;
			isAutoUseSkills[num2] = !isAutoUseSkills[num2];
			if (isAutoUseSkills[num2])
			{
				timeAutoSkills[num2] = -1L;
			}
			GameScr.info1.addInfo("Auto " + GameScr.keySkill[num2].template.name + (isAutoUseSkills[num2] ? (": " + NinjaUtil.getMoneys(timeAutoSkills[num2]) + " mili giây") : "\n[OFF]"), 0);
			break;
		}
		case 12:
			ChatTextField.gI().strChat = inputDelay[0];
			ChatTextField.gI().tfChat.name = inputDelay[1];
			ChatTextField.gI().startChat2(getInstance(), string.Empty);
			indexSkillAuto = (int)p;
			break;
		case 13:
            Skill mySkillreFreeze = GameScr.keySkill[(int)p];
            if (mySkillreFreeze.coolDown != 0)
            {
                mySkillreFreeze.coolDown = 0;
                if (mySkillreFreeze.template.manaUseType != 1)
                {
                    mySkillreFreeze.manaUse = 0;
                }
                GameScr.info1.addInfo("Đóng Băng\n" + mySkillreFreeze.template.name, 0);
            }
            else
            {
                if (MainMod.skillCooldowns.TryGetValue(mySkillreFreeze.template.id, out int myCooldown))
                {
                    mySkillreFreeze.coolDown = myCooldown;
                }
                if (MainMod.skillManause.TryGetValue(mySkillreFreeze.template.id, out int mymanause))
                {
                    mySkillreFreeze.manaUse = mymanause;
                }
                GameScr.info1.addInfo("Hủy đóng băng skill\n" + mySkillreFreeze.template.name, 0);
            }
            break;
		case 14:
			ShowMenuMassacre();
            break;
        case 15:
			ShowAttack();
            break;
        case 16:
            ChatTextField.gI().strChat = inputHPBossMobAttack[0];
            ChatTextField.gI().tfChat.name = inputHPBossMobAttack[1];
            ChatTextField.gI().startChat2(getInstance(), string.Empty);
            break;
        case 17:
            isAttack = !isAttack;
            GameScr.info1.addInfo("Tự động tấn công boss,mob theo ngưỡng máu\n" + ((isAttack) ? "[ON]" : "[OFF]"), 0);
            break;
        case 18:
            isAutoAttackOtherChars = !isAutoAttackOtherChars;
            GameScr.info1.addInfo("Tàn Sát Người\n" + (isAutoAttackOtherChars ? "[ON]" : "[OFF]"), 0);
            break;
        case 19:
            ChatTextField.gI().strChat = inputHPChar[0];
            ChatTextField.gI().tfChat.name = inputHPChar[1];
            ChatTextField.gI().startChat2(getInstance(), string.Empty);
            break;
        case 20:
            ShowMenuExclude();
            break;
        case 21:
            ShowMenuGenderDoSat();
            break;
        case 22:
            ChatTextField.gI().strChat = inputClanExclude[0];
            ChatTextField.gI().tfChat.name = inputClanExclude[1];
            ChatTextField.gI().startChat2(getInstance(), string.Empty);
            break;
        case 23:
            ChatTextField.gI().strChat = inputSymbolClanExclude[0];
            ChatTextField.gI().tfChat.name = inputSymbolClanExclude[1];
            ChatTextField.gI().startChat2(getInstance(), string.Empty);
            break;
        case 24:
            ShowListDoSat1();
            break;
        case 25:
            ShowListDoSat2();
            break;
        case 26:
            TSdetu = !TSdetu;
            GameScr.info1.addInfo("Tàn Sát Đệ\n" + (DoSatInMapnrsd ? "[ON]" : "[OFF]"), 0);
            break;
		case 27:
            DoSatInMapnrsd = !DoSatInMapnrsd;
            GameScr.info1.addInfo("Chỉ Tàn Sát Trong NRSD\n" + (DoSatInMapnrsd ? "[ON]" : "[OFF]"), 0);
            break;
        case 28:
            if (!FindListGender((int)p))
            {
                cGender.Add((int)p);
            }
            else
            {
                cGender.Remove((int)p);
            }
            ShowMenuGenderDoSat();
            break;
        case 29:
            clanExclude.RemoveAt((int)p);
            WriteDataTS("Data\\IDclan_Exclude.ini", clanExclude);
            ShowListDoSat1();
            break;
        case 30:
            kihieuclanExclude.RemoveAt((int)p);
            WriteDataTS("Data\\Symbol_Exclude.ini", kihieuclanExclude);
            ShowListDoSat2();
            break;
        }
    }

	private static void LoadKeySkills()
	{
		if (isSaveSkill)
		{
            GameScr.gI().saveKeySkillToRMS();
            return;
		}
		for (int i = 0; i < Char.myCharz().nClass.skillTemplates.Length; i++)
		{
			SkillTemplate skillTemplate = Char.myCharz().nClass.skillTemplates[i];
			Skill skill = Char.myCharz().getSkill(skillTemplate);
			if (skill != null)
			{
				GameScr.keySkill[i] = skill;
			}
			GameScr.gI().saveKeySkillToRMS();
		}
	}
    private static bool isMeInNRDMap()
    {
        if (TileMap.mapID >= 85)
        {
            return TileMap.mapID <= 91;
        }
        return false;
    }
    public static bool ReturnName(Char gclass131_0)
    {
        if (gclass131_0.cName != null && gclass131_0.cName != "" && gclass131_0.charID != -Char.myCharz().charID && gclass131_0.charID != Char.myCharz().charID && !gclass131_0.isPet && !gclass131_0.isMiniPet && char.IsUpper(char.Parse(gclass131_0.cName.Substring(0, 1))) && gclass131_0.cName != "Trọng tài" && !gclass131_0.cName.StartsWith("#"))
        {
            return !gclass131_0.cName.StartsWith("$");
        }
        return false;
    }

    public static string GetFirstNames(string name)
    {
        if (name != null)
        {
            return name.Split(new char[]
            {
            ']'
            })[0].Replace("[", "").Trim().ToUpper();
        }
        return "";
    }
    public static void TeleportTo(int x, int y)
    {
        if (Char.myCharz().isLockMove && Char.myCharz().npcFocus == null)
        {
            GameScr.info1.addInfo("Đang không thể di chuyển!", 0);
            return;
        }
        Char.myCharz().cx = x;
        Char.myCharz().cy = y;
        Service.gI().charMove();
        Char.myCharz().cx = x;
        Char.myCharz().cy = y + 1;
        Service.gI().charMove();
        Char.myCharz().cx = x;
        Char.myCharz().cy = y;
        Service.gI().charMove();
    }

    public static int cHpLimit()
    {
        if (limitHPChar != -1)
        {
            return limitHPChar;
        }
        return 2000000000;
    }
    public static bool Player(Char gclass131_0)
    {
        if (TileMap.mapID == 113)
        {
            if (gclass131_0 != null && Char.myCharz().myskill != null)
            {
                if (gclass131_0.cTypePk != 5)
                {
                    return gclass131_0.cTypePk == 3;
                }
                return true;
            }
            return false;
        }
        if (gclass131_0 != null && Char.myCharz().myskill != null)
        {
            if (gclass131_0.statusMe == 14 || gclass131_0.statusMe == 5 || Char.myCharz().myskill.template.type == 2 || ((Char.myCharz().cFlag != 8 || gclass131_0.cFlag == 0) && (Char.myCharz().cFlag == 0 || gclass131_0.cFlag != 8) && (Char.myCharz().cFlag == gclass131_0.cFlag || Char.myCharz().cFlag == 0 || gclass131_0.cFlag == 0) && (gclass131_0.cTypePk != 3 || Char.myCharz().cTypePk != 3) && Char.myCharz().cTypePk != 5 && gclass131_0.cTypePk != 5 && (Char.myCharz().cTypePk != 1 || gclass131_0.cTypePk != 1) && (Char.myCharz().cTypePk != 4 || gclass131_0.cTypePk != 4)))
            {
                if (Char.myCharz().myskill.template.type == 2)
                {
                    return gclass131_0.cTypePk != 5;
                }
                return false;
            }
            return true;
        }
        return false;
    }

    public static void TanSatPlayer()
    {
        if (!AutoSkill.isAutoSendAttack)
        {
            AutoSkill.isAutoSendAttack = true;
        }
        if (DoSatInMapnrsd && !isMeInNRDMap())
        {
            return;
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < GameScr.vCharInMap.size(); i++)
        {
            Char @char = (Char)GameScr.vCharInMap.elementAt(i);
            if (@char != null && !ReturnName(@char) && @char.cHP <= cHpLimit() && (TSdetu || (!TSdetu && @char.charID > 0)) && @char.cHP > 0 && Player(@char) && !@char.protectEff && cGender.Contains(@char.cgender))
            {
                if (@char.clanID == -1 || (@char.clanID != -1 && (!clanExclude.Contains(@char.clanID.ToString())) && (!kihieuclanExclude.Contains(GetFirstNames(@char.cName)))))
                {
                    Char.myCharz().charFocus = @char;
                    if (!Char.myCharz().isLockAttack && !Char.myCharz().isLockMove && Char.myCharz().charFocus != null && ((double)Math.abs(Char.myCharz().charFocus.cx - Char.myCharz().cx) >= (double)Char.myCharz().myskill.dx * 1.5 || (double)Math.abs(Char.myCharz().charFocus.cy - Char.myCharz().cy) >= (double)Char.myCharz().myskill.dy * 1.5) && mSystem.currentTimeMillis() - delayUseSkill >= 1500L)
                    {
                        delayUseSkill = mSystem.currentTimeMillis();
                        TeleportTo(Char.myCharz().charFocus.cx, Char.myCharz().charFocus.cy - 5);
                        break;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }

    public static void AutoSendAttack()
	{
		if (Char.myCharz().meDead || Char.myCharz().cHP <= 0 || Char.myCharz().statusMe == 14 || Char.myCharz().statusMe == 5 || Char.myCharz().myskill.template.type == 3 || Char.myCharz().myskill.template.id == 10 || Char.myCharz().myskill.template.id == 11 || (Char.myCharz().myskill.paintCanNotUseSkill && !GameCanvas.panel.isShow))
		{
			return;
		}
		int mySkillIndex = GetMySkillIndex();

        if (mSystem.currentTimeMillis() - lastTimeSendAttack[mySkillIndex] > GetCoolDown(Char.myCharz().myskill))
		{
			if (GameScr.gI().isMeCanAttackMob(Char.myCharz().mobFocus))
			{
				Char.myCharz().myskill.lastTimeUseThisSkill = mSystem.currentTimeMillis();
				SendAttackToMobFocus();
				//lastTimeSendAttack[mySkillIndex] = mSystem.currentTimeMillis();
			}
			else if (Char.myCharz().charFocus != null && isMeCanAttackChar(Char.myCharz().charFocus) && (double)Math.abs(Char.myCharz().charFocus.cx - Char.myCharz().cx) < (double)Char.myCharz().myskill.dx * 1.7)
			{
				Char.myCharz().myskill.lastTimeUseThisSkill = mSystem.currentTimeMillis();
				SendAttackToCharFocus();
				//lastTimeSendAttack[mySkillIndex] = mSystem.currentTimeMillis();
			}
		}
	}

	private static void AutoSkillForPet()
	{
		if (GameScr.vMob.size() == 0)
		{
			return;
		}
		Mob mobFocus = (Mob)GameScr.vMob.elementAt(0);
		int num = 0;
		for (int i = 0; i < GameScr.vMob.size(); i++)
		{
			Mob mob = (Mob)GameScr.vMob.elementAt(i);
			int num2 = Math.abs(Char.myCharz().cx - mob.x);
			int num3 = Math.abs(Char.myCharz().cy - mob.y);
			int num4 = num2 * num2 + num3 * num3;
			if (num < num4)
			{
				num = num4;
				mobFocus = mob;
			}
		}
		if (Char.myCharz().myskill != GameScr.keySkill[0])
		{
			GameScr.gI().doSelectSkill(GameScr.keySkill[0], isShortcut: true);
		}
		if (Char.myCharz().mobFocus == null)
		{
			Char.myCharz().mobFocus = mobFocus;
			return;
		}
		SendAttackToMobFocus();
		isPetAskedForUseSkill = false;
	}

	private static void AutoUseSkill(int skillIndex)
	{
		if (TileMap.mapID == 21 || TileMap.mapID == 22 || TileMap.mapID == 23)
		{
			return;
		}
		if (skillIndex >= GameScr.keySkill.Length)
		{
			skillIndex = GameScr.keySkill.Length - 1;
		}
		if (skillIndex < 0)
		{
			skillIndex = 0;
		}
		if (GameScr.keySkill[skillIndex].coolDown == 0)
		{
			timeAutoSkills[skillIndex] = -1;
		}
        if (GameScr.keySkill[skillIndex] == null || GameScr.keySkill[skillIndex].paintCanNotUseSkill|| Char.myCharz().sleepEff || Char.myCharz().holdEffID != 0|| (GameScr.keySkill[skillIndex] == Char.myCharz().getSkill(Char.myCharz().nClass.skillTemplates[8])&& Char.myCharz().protectEff))
        {
            return;
        }
        else if (isMeHasEnoughMP(GameScr.keySkill[skillIndex]) && !GameScr.gI().isCharging() && mSystem.currentTimeMillis() - lastTimeAutoUseSkill > 150L)
		{
			if (timeAutoSkills[skillIndex] == -1 && GameCanvas.gameTick % 20 == 0)
			{
				lastTimeUseSkill[skillIndex] = mSystem.currentTimeMillis();
				lastTimeAutoUseSkill = mSystem.currentTimeMillis();
				GameScr.gI().doSelectSkill(GameScr.keySkill[skillIndex], isShortcut: true);
			}
			if (mSystem.currentTimeMillis() - lastTimeUseSkill[skillIndex] > timeAutoSkills[skillIndex])
			{
				lastTimeUseSkill[skillIndex] = mSystem.currentTimeMillis();
				lastTimeAutoUseSkill = mSystem.currentTimeMillis();
				GameScr.gI().doSelectSkill(GameScr.keySkill[skillIndex], isShortcut: true);
			}
		}
	}

	public static bool isMeCanAttackChar(Char ch)
	{
		if (TileMap.mapID == 113)
		{
			if (ch != null && Char.myCharz().myskill != null)
			{
				if (ch.cTypePk != 5)
				{
					return ch.cTypePk == 3;
				}
				return true;
			}
			return false;
		}
		if (ch != null && Char.myCharz().myskill != null)
		{
			if (ch.statusMe != 14 && ch.statusMe != 5 && Char.myCharz().myskill.template.type != 2 && ((Char.myCharz().cFlag == 8 && ch.cFlag != 0) || (Char.myCharz().cFlag != 0 && ch.cFlag == 8) || (Char.myCharz().cFlag != ch.cFlag && Char.myCharz().cFlag != 0 && ch.cFlag != 0) || (ch.cTypePk == 3 && Char.myCharz().cTypePk == 3) || Char.myCharz().cTypePk == 5 || ch.cTypePk == 5 || (Char.myCharz().cTypePk == 1 && ch.cTypePk == 1) || (Char.myCharz().cTypePk == 4 && ch.cTypePk == 4)))
			{
				return true;
			}
			if (Char.myCharz().myskill.template.type == 2)
			{
				return ch.cTypePk != 5;
			}
            if (Char.myCharz().myskill.template.type == 4)
            {
				return false;
            }
            return false;
		}

        return false;
	}

	private static bool isMeHasEnoughMP(Skill skillToUse)
	{
		if (skillToUse.template.manaUseType == 2)
		{
			return true;
		}
		if (skillToUse.template.manaUseType != 1)
		{
			return Char.myCharz().cMP >= skillToUse.manaUse;
		}
		return Char.myCharz().cMP >= skillToUse.manaUse * Char.myCharz().cMPFull / 100;
	}

		//{

	public static int GetMySkillIndex()
	{
		int num = 0;
		while (true)
		{
			if (num < GameScr.keySkill.Length)
			{
				if (GameScr.keySkill[num] == Char.myCharz().myskill)
				{
					break;
				}
				num++;
				continue;
			}
			return 0;
		}
		return num;
	}

	private static void AutoChangeFocus()
	{
		if (listTargetAutoChangeFocus.Count == 0)
		{
			GameScr.info1.addInfo("Danh sách chuyển mục tiêu trống!", 0);
			isAutoChangeFocus = false;
		}
		else
		{
			if (Char.myCharz().meDead || Char.myCharz().statusMe == 14 || Char.myCharz().statusMe == 5 || Char.myCharz().myskill.template.type == 3 || Char.myCharz().myskill.template.id == 10 || Char.myCharz().myskill.template.id == 11 || Char.myCharz().myskill.paintCanNotUseSkill)
			{
				return;
			}
			cooldownAutoChangeFocus = GetCooldownAutoChangeFocus(Char.myCharz().myskill);
			if (targetIndex >= listTargetAutoChangeFocus.Count)
			{
				targetIndex = 0;
			}
			if (mSystem.currentTimeMillis() - lastTimeChangeFocus >= cooldownAutoChangeFocus)
			{
				lastTimeChangeFocus = mSystem.currentTimeMillis();
				Char.myCharz().charFocus = GameScr.findCharInMap(listTargetAutoChangeFocus[targetIndex].charID);
				targetIndex++;
				if (targetIndex >= listTargetAutoChangeFocus.Count)
				{
					targetIndex = 0;
				}
				if (Char.myCharz().charFocus != null && isMeCanAttackChar(Char.myCharz().charFocus) && (double)Math.abs(Char.myCharz().charFocus.cx - Char.myCharz().cx) < (double)Char.myCharz().myskill.dx * 1.5)
				{
					Char.myCharz().myskill.lastTimeUseThisSkill = mSystem.currentTimeMillis();
					SendAttackToCharFocus();
                }
            }
        }
	}

	private static long GetCooldownAutoChangeFocus(Skill skill)
	{
		if (skill.coolDown <= 500)
		{
			return 1000L;
		}
		return (long)((double)skill.coolDown * 1.2 + 200.0);
	}

	public static void FreezeSelectedSkill()
	{
        Skill mySkillreFreeze = Char.myCharz().myskill;
        if (mySkillreFreeze.coolDown != 0)
		{
			mySkillreFreeze.coolDown = 0;
			if (mySkillreFreeze.template.manaUseType != 1)
			{
				mySkillreFreeze.manaUse = 0;
			}
            GameScr.info1.addInfo("Đóng Băng\n" + mySkillreFreeze.template.name, 0);
		}
		else
		{
            if (MainMod.skillCooldowns.TryGetValue(mySkillreFreeze.template.id, out int myCooldown))
            {
                mySkillreFreeze.coolDown = myCooldown;
            }
            if (MainMod.skillManause.TryGetValue(mySkillreFreeze.template.id, out int mymanause))
            {
                mySkillreFreeze.manaUse = mymanause;
            }
            GameScr.info1.addInfo("Hủy đóng băng skill\n"+ mySkillreFreeze.template.name, 0);
        }
	}

	public static void SendMyCharAttack()
	{
		MyVector myVector = new MyVector();
		myVector.addElement(Char.myCharz());
		Service.gI().sendPlayerAttack(new MyVector(), myVector, 2);

	private static void AutoProtect()
	{
		if (TileMap.mapID != 21+Char.myCharz().cgender && !Char.myCharz().getSkill(Char.myCharz().nClass.skillTemplates[8]).paintCanNotUseSkill && isMeHasEnoughMP(Char.myCharz().getSkill(Char.myCharz().nClass.skillTemplates[8])) && !GameScr.gI().isCharging() && !Char.myCharz().protectEff && !Char.myCharz().isBlind && !Char.myCharz().sleepEff && Char.myCharz().holdEffID == 0 && mSystem.currentTimeMillis() - timeUseProtect >= 150)
		{
			timeUseProtect = mSystem.currentTimeMillis();
			GameScr.gI().doSelectSkill(Char.myCharz().getSkill(Char.myCharz().nClass.skillTemplates[8]), isShortcut: true);
		}
	}

	private static int Keyskill()
	{
		for (int i = 0; i < GameScr.keySkill.Length; i++)
		{
			if (GameScr.keySkill[i] == Char.myCharz().myskill)
			{
				return i;
			}
		}
		return 0;
	}
}

	private static void LoadData()
	{
		isSaveData = Rms.loadRMSInt("AutoPeanIsSaveRms") == 1;
		if (isSaveData)
		{
			isAutoRequestPean = Rms.loadRMSInt("AutoPeanIsAutoRequestPean") == 1;
			isAutoDonatePean = Rms.loadRMSInt("AutoPeanIsAutoSendPean") == 1;
			isAutoHarvestPean = Rms.loadRMSInt("AutoPeanIsAutoHarvestPean") == 1;
			if (Rms.loadRMSInt("AutoPeanPercentHP") == -1)
			{
				minimumHPPercent = 0;
			}
			else
			{
				minimumHPPercent = Rms.loadRMSInt("AutoPeanPercentHP");
			}
			if (Rms.loadRMSInt("AutoPeanPercentMP") == -1)
			{
				minimumMPPercent = 0;
			}
			else
			{
				minimumMPPercent = Rms.loadRMSInt("AutoPeanPercentMP");
			}
			if (Rms.loadRMSString("AutoPeanHP") == null)
			{
				minimumHP = 0;
			}
			else
			{
				minimumHP = int.Parse(Rms.loadRMSString("AutoPeanHP"));
			}
			if (Rms.loadRMSString("AutoPeanMP") == null)
			{
				minimumMP = 0;
			}
			else
			{
				minimumMP = int.Parse(Rms.loadRMSString("AutoPeanMP"));
			}
		}
	}

	private static void SaveData()
	{
		Rms.saveRMSInt("AutoPeanIsAutoRequestPean", isAutoRequestPean ? 1 : 0);
		Rms.saveRMSInt("AutoPeanIsAutoSendPean", isAutoDonatePean ? 1 : 0);
		Rms.saveRMSInt("AutoPeanIsAutoHarvestPean", isAutoHarvestPean ? 1 : 0);
		Rms.saveRMSString("AutoPeanHP", minimumHP.ToString());
		Rms.saveRMSInt("AutoPeanPercentHP", minimumHPPercent);
		Rms.saveRMSString("AutoPeanMP", minimumMP.ToString());
		Rms.saveRMSInt("AutoPeanPercentMP", minimumMPPercent);
	}

	private static void ResetChatTextField()
	{
		ChatTextField.gI().strChat = "Chat";
		ChatTextField.gI().tfChat.name = "chat";
		ChatTextField.gI().isShow = false;
	}

	private static void RequestPean()
	{
		if (mSystem.currentTimeMillis() - lastTimeRequestedPean >= 301000)
		{
			lastTimeRequestedPean = mSystem.currentTimeMillis();
			Service.gI().clanMessage(1, "", -1);
		}
	}

	private static void DonatePean()
	{
		int num = 0;
		ClanMessage clanMessage;
		while (true)
		{
			if (num < ClanMessage.vMessage.size())
			{
				clanMessage = (ClanMessage)ClanMessage.vMessage.elementAt(num);
				if (clanMessage.maxCap != 0 && clanMessage.playerName != Char.myCharz().cName && clanMessage.recieve != clanMessage.maxCap)
				{
					break;
				}
				num++;
				continue;
			}
			return;
		}
		Service.gI().clanDonate(clanMessage.id);
	}

	private static void HarvestPean()
	{
		if (TileMap.mapID != 21 && TileMap.mapID != 22 && TileMap.mapID != 23)
		{
			return;
		}
		int num = 0;
		for (int i = 0; i < Char.myCharz().arrItemBox.Length; i++)
		{
			if (Char.myCharz().arrItemBox[i] != null && Char.myCharz().arrItemBox[i].template.type == 6)
			{
				num += Char.myCharz().arrItemBox[i].quantity;
			}
		}
		if (num < 20 && GameCanvas.gameTick % 100 == 0)
		{
			for (int j = 0; j < Char.myCharz().arrItemBag.Length; j++)
			{
				if (Char.myCharz().arrItemBag[j] != null && Char.myCharz().arrItemBag[j].template.type == 6)
				{
					Service.gI().getItem(1, (sbyte)j);
					break;
				}
			}
		}
		if (GameScr.gI().magicTree.currPeas > 0 && (GameScr.hpPotion < 10 || num < 20) && GameCanvas.gameTick % 200 == 0)
		{
			Service.gI().openMenu(4);
			Service.gI().menu(4, 0, 0);
		}
	}

	private static void AutoUsePean()
	{
		if (GameScr.hpPotion > 0)
		{
			if (minimumHPPercent != 0 && isMyHPLowerThan(minimumHP, minimumHPPercent) && GameCanvas.gameTick % 20 == 0)
			{
				GameScr.gI().doUseHP();
			}
			else if (minimumMPPercent != 0 && isMyMPLowerThan(minimumMP, minimumMPPercent) && GameCanvas.gameTick % 20 == 0)
			{
				GameScr.gI().doUseHP();
			}
		}
	}

	private static int MyHPPercent()
	{
		return (int)((long)Char.myCharz().cHP * 100L / Char.myCharz().cHPFull);
	}

	private static int MyMPPercent()
	{
		return (int)((long)Char.myCharz().cMP * 100L / Char.myCharz().cMPFull);
	}

	private static bool isMyHPLowerThan(int minHP, int minHPPercent)
	{
		if (Char.myCharz().cHP > 0)
		{
			if (MyHPPercent() > minHPPercent)
			{
				return Char.myCharz().cHP < minHP;
			}
			return true;
		}
		return false;
	}

	private static bool isMyMPLowerThan(int minMP, int minMPPercent)
	{
		if (Char.myCharz().cHP > 0)
		{
			if (MyMPPercent() > minMPPercent)
			{
				return Char.myCharz().cMP < minMP;
			}
			return true;
		}
		return false;
	}

	static AutoPean()
	{
		inputHPPercent = new string[2] { "Nhập %HP Pean", "%HP" };
		inputMPPercent = new string[2] { "Nhập %MP Pean", "%MP" };
		inputHP = new string[2] { "Nhập HP Pean", "HP" };
		inputMP = new string[2] { "Nhập MP Pean", "MP" };
		LoadData();
	}
}

	public static void DoIt()
	{
        long cTiemNang = Char.myCharz().cTiemNang;
        int cHPGoc = Char.myCharz().cHPGoc;
        int cMPGoc = Char.myCharz().cMPGoc;
        int cDamGoc = Char.myCharz().cDamGoc;
        int cDefGoc = Char.myCharz().cDefGoc;
        int cCriticalGoc = Char.myCharz().cCriticalGoc;
        int num = 0;
        int num2 = 1000;

        if (cDamGoc < damageToAuto)
		{
            if (cTiemNang > cDamGoc && cTiemNang < 10 * (2 * cDamGoc + 9) / 2 * Char.myCharz().expForOneAdd)
            {
                Service.gI().upPotential(2, 1);
            }
            if (cTiemNang >= 10 * (2 * cDamGoc + 9) / 2 * Char.myCharz().expForOneAdd && cTiemNang < 100 * (2 * cDamGoc + 99) / 2 * Char.myCharz().expForOneAdd)
            {
                Service.gI().upPotential(2, 10);
            }
            if (cTiemNang >= 100 * (2 * cDamGoc + 99) / 2 * Char.myCharz().expForOneAdd)
            {
                Service.gI().upPotential(2, 100);
            }
        }
		else if (cHPGoc < hpToAuto)
		{
            if (cTiemNang > cHPGoc && cTiemNang < 10 * (2 * (cHPGoc + num2) + 180) / 2)
            {
                Service.gI().upPotential(0, 1);
            }
            if (cTiemNang >= 10 * (2 * (cHPGoc + num2) + 180) / 2 && cTiemNang < 100 * (2 * (cHPGoc + num2) + 1980) / 2)
            {
                Service.gI().upPotential(0, 10);
            }
            if (cTiemNang >= 100 * (2 * (cHPGoc + num2) + 1980) / 2)
            {
                Service.gI().upPotential(0, 100);
            }
		}
		else if (cMPGoc < mpToAuto)
		{
            if (cTiemNang > cMPGoc && cTiemNang < 10 * (2 * (cMPGoc + num2) + 180) / 2)
            {
                Service.gI().upPotential(1, 1);
            }
            if (cTiemNang >= 10 * (2 * (cMPGoc + num2) + 180) / 2 && cTiemNang < 100 * (2 * (cMPGoc + num2) + 1980) / 2)
            {
                Service.gI().upPotential(1, 10);
            }
            if (cTiemNang >= 100 * (2 * (cMPGoc + num2) + 1980) / 2)

            }
        }

## File: rs/Mod/TcpConnect.cs
﻿using System.IO;
using System.Net.Sockets;
using System.Net;
using System.Text;
using System.Threading;

namespace NRO
{
    public class TcpConnect
    {
        public static bool StartConnect;
        public static IPEndPoint IP;
        public static Stream stream;
        public static Socket client;
        public int port;
        public void Connect()
        {
            try
            {
                port = int.Parse(File.ReadAllText("Data\\port.ini"));
            }
            catch
            {
                port = 9050;
            }
            try
            {
                IP = new IPEndPoint(IPAddress.Parse("127.0.0.1"), port);
                client = new Socket(AddressFamily.InterNetwork, SocketType.Stream, ProtocolType.Tcp);
                client.Connect(IP);
                Thread Listen = new Thread(Recieve);
                Listen.IsBackground = true;
                Listen.Start();
            }
            catch
            {
                GameScr.info1.addInfo("Chưa mở bảng điều khiển", 0);
                MainMod.isConnectToAccountManager = false;
            }

        }
        public void Recieve()
        {
            try
            {
                while (true)
                {
                    byte[] data = new byte[1024];
                    client.Receive(data);
                    string Mess = (string)DeSerialize(data);
                    MainMod.GetMessServer = Mess;
                }
            }
            catch
            {
                MainMod.isConnectToAccountManager = false;
                CloseClient();
            }
        }
        public void CloseClient()
        {
            client.Close();
        }
        object DeSerialize(byte[] data)
        {
            return Encoding.UTF8.GetString(data);
        }
    }
}

using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Threading;

namespace NRO;

public class AutoItem : IActionListener, IChatable
{
	public class Item
	{
		public int Id;

		public string Name;

		public int Quantity;

		public short Index;

		public bool IsGold;

		public bool IsSell;

		public int Delay;

		public long LastTimeUse;

		public Item()
		{
		}

		public Item(int id, string name)
		{
			Id = id;
			Name = name;
		}

		public Item(int id, short isGold, bool index, bool isSell)
		{
			Id = id;
			IsGold = index;
			Index = isGold;
			IsSell = isSell;
		}
	}

	private static AutoItem _Instance;

	private static List<Item> listItemAuto = new List<Item>();

	private static Item itemToAuto;

	public static List<string> set1 = new List<string>();

	public static List<string> set2 = new List<string>();

	private static bool isChangingSet;

	private static string[] inputDelay = new string[2] { "Nhập delay", "giây" };

	private static string[] inputSellQuantity = new string[2] { "Nhập số lượng bán", "số lượng" };

	private static string[] inputBuyQuantity = new string[2] { "Nhập số lượng mua", "số lượng" };

    public static bool lateChange;

    public static AutoItem getInstance()
	{
		if (_Instance == null)
		{
			_Instance = new AutoItem();
		}
		return _Instance;
	}

	public static void Update()
	{
		if (listItemAuto.Count <= 0)
		{
			return;
		}
		int num = 0;
		Item item;
		while (true)
		{
			if (num < listItemAuto.Count)
			{
				item = listItemAuto[num];
				if (mSystem.currentTimeMillis() - item.LastTimeUse > item.Delay * 1000)
				{
					break;
				}
				num++;
				continue;
			}
			return;
		}
		item.LastTimeUse = mSystem.currentTimeMillis();
		Service.gI().useItem(0, 1, -1, (short)item.Id);
	}

	public void onChatFromMe(string text, string to)
	{
		if (ChatTextField.gI().tfChat.getText() != null && !ChatTextField.gI().tfChat.getText().Equals(string.Empty) && !text.Equals(string.Empty) && text != null)
		{
			if (ChatTextField.gI().strChat.Equals(inputDelay[0]))
			{
				try
				{
					int delay = int.Parse(ChatTextField.gI().tfChat.getText());
					itemToAuto.Delay = delay;

					listItemAuto.Add(itemToAuto);
				}
				catch
				{
					GameScr.info1.addInfo("Delay Không Hợp Lệ, Vui Lòng Nhập Lại!", 0);
				}
				ResetChatTextField();
			}
			else if (ChatTextField.gI().strChat.Equals(inputBuyQuantity[0]))
			{
				try
				{
					int quantity = int.Parse(ChatTextField.gI().tfChat.getText());
					itemToAuto.Quantity = quantity;
					new Thread((ThreadStart)delegate
					{
						AutoBuy(itemToAuto);
					}).Start();
				}
				catch
				{
					GameScr.info1.addInfo("Số Lượng Không Hợp Lệ, Vui Lòng Nhập Lại!", 0);
				}
				ResetChatTextField();
			}
			else
			{
				if (!ChatTextField.gI().strChat.Equals(inputSellQuantity[0]))
				{
					return;
				}
				try

	}

			break;

	public static bool isAutoUse(int templateId)
	{
		int num = 0;
		while (true)
		{
			if (num < listItemAuto.Count)
			{
				if (listItemAuto[num].Id == templateId)
				{
					break;
				}
				num++;
				continue;
			}
			return false;
		}
		return true;
	}

	private static void RemoveItemAuto(int templateId)
	{
		int num = 0;
		while (true)
		{
			if (num < listItemAuto.Count)
			{
				if (listItemAuto[num].Id == templateId)
				{
					break;
				}
				num++;
				continue;
			}
			return;
		}
		listItemAuto.RemoveAt(num);
	}

	{
		itemToAuto = item;

		if (item.IsSell)
		{
			ChatTextField.gI().strChat = inputSellQuantity[0];
			ChatTextField.gI().tfChat.name = inputSellQuantity[1];
		}
		else
		{
			ChatTextField.gI().strChat = inputBuyQuantity[0];
			ChatTextField.gI().tfChat.name = inputBuyQuantity[1];
		}
		ChatTextField.gI().startChat2(getInstance(), string.Empty);
	}

	private static void AutoSell(Item item)
	{
		Thread.Sleep(100);
		short index = item.Index;
		while (true)
		{
			if (item.Quantity > 0)
			{
				if (Char.myCharz().arrItemBag[index] == null || (Char.myCharz().arrItemBag[index] != null && Char.myCharz().arrItemBag[index].template.id != (short)item.Id))
				{
					break;
				}
				Service.gI().saleItem(0, 1, (short)(index + 3));
				Thread.Sleep(100);
				Service.gI().saleItem(1, 1, index);
				Thread.Sleep(1000);
				item.Quantity--;
				if (Char.myCharz().xu > 1963100000)
				{
					GameScr.info1.addInfo("Xong!", 0);
					return;
				}
				continue;
			}
			GameScr.info1.addInfo("Xong!", 0);
			return;
		}
		GameScr.info1.addInfo("Không Tìm Thấy Item!", 0);
	}

	private void AutoBuy(Item item)
	{
		while (item.Quantity > 0 && !GameScr.gI().isBagFull())
		{
			Service.gI().buyItem((sbyte)((!item.IsGold) ? 1 : 0), item.Id, 0);
			item.Quantity--;
			Thread.Sleep(1000);
		}
		GameScr.info1.addInfo("Xong!", 0);
	}

	public static void useSet(int type)
	{
        if (isChangingSet)
        {
            return;
        }
        new Thread((ThreadStart)delegate
		{
			if (type == 0)
			{
				ChangeSet(set1);
				lateChange = true;

            }
			if (type == 1)
			{
				ChangeSet(set2);
				lateChange = false;

            }
		}).Start();
	}

	private static void ChangeSet(List<string> set)
	{
		if (isChangingSet)
		{
			GameScr.info1.addInfo("Đang Mặc Đồ!", 0);
			return;
		}
		isChangingSet = true;
		for (int num = Char.myCharz().arrItemBag.Length - 1; num >= 0; num--)
		{
			global::Item item = Char.myCharz().arrItemBag[num];
			if (item != null && set.Contains(item.getFullName()))
			{
				Service.gI().getItem(4, (sbyte)num);
				Thread.Sleep(100);
			}
		}
		isChangingSet = false;
	}
}

﻿using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Linq;
using System.Text;

namespace NRO
{
    public class MyAnimation
    {
        public static int getR(int color)
        {
            return color >> 16 & 255;
        }

        public static int getG(int color)
        {
            return color >> 8 & 255;
        }

        public static int getB(int color)
        {
            return color & 255;
        }
        public static void fillGradientRect(mGraphics g, int x, int y, int w, int h, int colorCenter, int colorEdge, int shortLen)
        {
            int num = h - 1;
            for (int i = 0; i < num; i++)
            {
                float num2 = (float)i / (float)(num - 1);
                int num5 = (int)((float)MyAnimation.getR(colorCenter) * (1f - num2) + (float)MyAnimation.getR(colorEdge) * num2);
                int num3 = (int)((float)MyAnimation.getG(colorCenter) * (1f - num2) + (float)MyAnimation.getG(colorEdge) * num2);
                int num4 = (int)((float)MyAnimation.getB(colorCenter) * (1f - num2) + (float)MyAnimation.getB(colorEdge) * num2);
                int color = num5 << 16 | num3 << 8 | num4;
                g.setColor(color);
                if (i <= shortLen - 2)
                {
                    g.fillRect(x + i + 1, y + i * h / num, w + (i - 2), h / num + 2);
                }
                else if (num - i <= shortLen - 2)
                {
                    g.fillRect(x + 2 - (num - i), y + i * h / num, w - (num - i), h / num + 2);
                }
                else
                {
                    g.fillRect(x, y + i * h / num, w + 1, h / num + 2);
                }
            }
        }

        public static void drawSparkles(mGraphics g, int x, int y, int w, int h)
        {
            int sparkleX = Res.random(x + 3, x + w / 2);
            int sparkleY = Res.random(y + h / 2, y + h - 3);
            int sparkleX2 = Res.random(x + w / 2, x + w - 3);
            int sparkleY2 = Res.random(y + h / 2, y + h - 3);
            if (GameCanvas.gameTick % 2 == 0)
            {
                g.setColor(16777215);
                g.fillRect(sparkleX, sparkleY, 1, 1);
                g.fillRect(sparkleX2, sparkleY2, 1, 1);
            }
        }
        public static void FillTriangle(mGraphics g, int x0, int y0, int x1, int y1, int x2, int y2)
        {
            // Sắp xếp đỉnh theo thứ tự từ trên xuống dưới
            if (y1 < y0) { Swap(ref x0, ref x1); Swap(ref y0, ref y1); }
            if (y2 < y0) { Swap(ref x0, ref x2); Swap(ref y0, ref y2); }
            if (y2 < y1) { Swap(ref x1, ref x2); Swap(ref y1, ref y2); }

            int totalHeight = y2 - y0;
            for (int i = 0; i < totalHeight; i++)
            {
                bool secondHalf = i > y1 - y0 || y1 == y0;
                int segmentHeight = secondHalf ? y2 - y1 : y1 - y0;

                float alpha = (float)i / totalHeight;
                float beta = (float)(i - (secondHalf ? (y1 - y0) : 0)) / segmentHeight;

                int ax = x0 + (int)((x2 - x0) * alpha);
                int bx = secondHalf
                    ? x1 + (int)((x2 - x1) * beta)
                    : x0 + (int)((x1 - x0) * beta);

                if (ax > bx) { Swap(ref ax, ref bx); }

                g.fillRect(ax, y0 + i, bx - ax + 1, 1);
            }
        }

        private static void Swap(ref int a, ref int b)
        {
            int temp = a;
            a = b;
            b = temp;
        }
    }
}

## File: rs/Mod/Phacap.cs
using System;
using System.Collections.Specialized;
using System.IO;
using System.Net;
using System.Text;
using System.Threading;

namespace NRO;

public class Phacap
{
	public static string KeyCapcha;

	public static bool khoa = false;

	public static string textsuccess;

	public static async Task solvecap(string text)
	{
		if (khoa) return;
		khoa = true;
		try
		{
			if ((MobCapcha.isAttack && MobCapcha.explode) || GameScr.gI().mobCapcha == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			int num = (int)mSystem.currentTimeMillis();
			await Task.Delay(2000);
			int num2 = (int)mSystem.currentTimeMillis() - num;
			if (num2 < 5000)
			{
				await Task.Delay(5000 - num2);
			}
			if (text.Length >= 4 && text.Length <= 7)
			{
				Mob mobCapcha = GameScr.gI().mobCapcha;
				int retry = 0;
                while (GameScr.gI().mobCapcha != null && GameScr.gI().mobCapcha == mobCapcha&&retry < 3)
				{
					GameScr gameScr = GameScr.gI();
					gameScr.keyInput = "";
					for (int i = 0; i < text.Length; i++)
					{
                        gameScr.keyInput += text[i];
						Service.gI().mobCapcha(text[i]);
						await Task.Delay(Res.random(500, 1000));
					}
					retry++;
                    await Task.Delay(2000);
				}
				if(retry >= 3)
				{
					Program.Cleanup();
                }
            }
		}
		catch (Exception)
		{
		}
		finally
		{
            await Task.Delay(5000);
			khoa = false;
        }
    }
}

using static System.Runtime.InteropServices.JavaScript.JSType;

namespace NRO;

public class AutoMap : IActionListener
{
	public class NextMap
	{
		public int MapID;

		public int Npc;

		public int[] Index;

		private int type;

		private object[] info;

        public NextMap(int mapnextID, int npcID, int[] index, int typemove, object[] captions)
		{
			MapID = mapnextID;
			Npc = npcID;
			Index = index;
            type= typemove;
			info = captions;
        }

		public void GotoMap()
		{
			if (Index == null) return;
			switch(type)
			{
				case Type.next_move:
                    Waypoint wayPoint = GetWayPoint();
                    if (wayPoint != null) Enter(wayPoint);
                    break;
                case Type.moveto:
                    Waypoint wayPoint2 = GetWayPoint();
					if (wayPoint2 != null)
					{
						TeleportTo((int)info[0], (int)info[1]);
						ChangeMap(wayPoint2);
					}
                    break;
				case Type.npc_move:
					npcMove(Type.npc_move);
                    break;
				case Type.textmenu_move:
					npcMove(Type.textmenu_move);
                    break;
				case Type.useitem_move:
					break;
            }
		}

		private void npcMove(int type)
		{
            if (Npc == -1 || Index == null)
            {
                return;
            }
            Service.gI().openMenu(Npc);
            for (int i = 0; i < GameCanvas.menu.menuItems.size(); i++)
            {
                string caption = ((Command)GameCanvas.menu.menuItems.elementAt(i)).caption.Replace('\n', ' ').ToLower();
                if (caption.Contains("refuse candy") || caption.Contains("từ chối nhận kẹo") || caption.Contains("chúc mừng năm mới") || caption.Contains("happy new year"))
                {
                    longCloseClick = mSystem.currentTimeMillis();
                    GameCanvas.menu.menuSelectedItem = i;
                    GameCanvas.gI().keyPressedz(-5);
                    break;
                }
                if (caption.Contains("Chúc mừng") || caption.Contains("merry"))
                {
                    for (int j = 0; j < GameCanvas.menu.menuItems.size(); j++)
                    {
                        if (((Command)GameCanvas.menu.menuItems.elementAt(j)).caption.Contains("OK"))
                        {
                            longCloseClick = mSystem.currentTimeMillis();
                            GameCanvas.menu.menuSelectedItem = j;
                            GameCanvas.gI().keyPressedz(-5);
                            break;
                        }
                    }
                    break;
                }
				if (type == Type.npc_move)
				{
					for (int k = 0; k < Index.Length; k++)
					{
						longCloseClick = mSystem.currentTimeMillis();
						Service.gI().confirmMenu(0, (sbyte)Index[k]);
					}
					return;
				};
                for (int k = 0; k < Index.Length; k++)
                {
					if (Index[k] == -1)
					{
						for(int j = 0; j < GameCanvas.menu.menuItems.size(); j++)
						{
							if (((Command)GameCanvas.menu.menuItems.elementAt(j)).caption.Replace('\n', ' ').Contains(info[0].ToString()))
							{
                                longCloseClick = mSystem.currentTimeMillis();
                                GameCanvas.menu.menuSelectedItem = j;
								Service.gI().confirmMenu(0, (sbyte)j);
                                GameCanvas.gI().keyPressedz(-5);
								break;
							}
                        }
					}
					else
					{
						longCloseClick = mSystem.currentTimeMillis();
                        Service.gI().confirmMenu(0, (sbyte)Index[k]);
                    }
                }
            }
        }

		public Waypoint GetWayPoint()
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < TileMap.vGo.size(); i++)
			{
				Waypoint waypoint = (Waypoint)TileMap.vGo.elementAt(i);
				if (GetMapName().Equals(GetMapName(waypoint.popup)))
				{
					return waypoint;
				}
			}
			return null;
		}

		public string GetMapName()
		{
			return TileMap.mapNames[MapID];
		}
        public string GetMapName(PopUp popup)
        {
            StringBuilder stringBuilder = new StringBuilder();
            for (int i = 0; i < popup.says.Length; i++)
            {
                stringBuilder.Append(popup.says[i]);
                stringBuilder.Append(" ");
            }
            return stringBuilder.ToString().Trim();
        }
        private static void ChangeMap(Waypoint waypoint)
		{
            if (waypoint.isOffline)
            {
                Service.gI().getMapOffline();
                return;
            }
            Service.gI().requestChangeMap();
        }
		public void Enter(Waypoint waypoint)
		{
			int num = ((waypoint.maxX < 60) ? 44 : ((waypoint.minX <= TileMap.pxw - 60) ? ((waypoint.minX + waypoint.maxX) / 2) : (TileMap.pxw - 44)));
			int maxY = waypoint.maxY;
			if (num == -1 || maxY == -1)
			{
				GameScr.info1.addInfo("Có lỗi xảy ra", 0);
				return;
			}
			if (Char.myCharz().cx != num) { TeleportTo(num, maxY); }
			waypoint.popup.doClick((int)(LongWaitNextMap/1000L)+1);
            ChangeMap(waypoint);
        }

		public void TeleportTo(int x, int y)
		{
			if (Char.myCharz().isLockMove && Char.myCharz().npcFocus == null)
			{
				return;
			}
            Char.myCharz().currentMovePoint = null;
            Char.myCharz().cx = x;
			Char.myCharz().cy = y;
			Service.gI().charMove();
			if (!GameScr.canAutoPlay)
			{
				Char.myCharz().cx = x;
				Char.myCharz().cy = y + 1;
				Service.gI().charMove();
				Char.myCharz().cx = x;
				Char.myCharz().cy = y;
				Service.gI().charMove();
			}
		}
	}

	public static void Update()
	{
		if (Char.myCharz().meDead)
		{
			lastWaitTime = mSystem.currentTimeMillis() + 1000L;
		}
		if (TileMap.mapID == IdMapEnd)
		{
			FinishXmap();
			return;
		}
		if (!isXmaping || Char.myCharz().cHP <= 0|| Char.myCharz().meDead)return;
		//bool flag = false;
		if ((TileMap.mapID == 21 || TileMap.mapID == 22 || TileMap.mapID == 23))
        {
			if (isEatChicken)
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < GameScr.vItemMap.size(); i++)
				{
					ItemMap itemMap = (ItemMap)GameScr.vItemMap.elementAt(i);
					if ((itemMap.playerId == Char.myCharz().charID || itemMap.playerId == -1) && itemMap.template.id == 74)
					{
						//flag = true;
						Char.myCharz().itemFocus = itemMap;
						if (mSystem.currentTimeMillis() - lastWaitTime > 600L)
						{
							lastWaitTime = mSystem.currentTimeMillis();
							Service.gI().pickItem(Char.myCharz().itemFocus.itemMapID);
							break;
						}
						return;
					}
				}
			}
			if (isHarvestPean && GameScr.hpPotion < 10 && GameScr.gI().magicTree.currPeas > 0 && mSystem.currentTimeMillis() - lastWaitTime > 1000)
			{
				lastWaitTime = mSystem.currentTimeMillis();
				Service.gI().openMenu(4);
				Service.gI().menu(4, 0, 0);
			}
		}
		if (mSystem.currentTimeMillis() - lastWaitTime <= 1000L || mSystem.currentTimeMillis() - LastNextMap <= LongWaitNextMap) return;

		LastNextMap = mSystem.currentTimeMillis();
        if (isFutureMap(IdMapEnd))
		{
            if (GameScr.findNPCInMap(38) == null)
			{
				if (TileMap.mapID == 27)
				{
					UpdateXmap(28);
					return;
				}
				if (TileMap.mapID == 29)
				{
					UpdateXmap(28);
					return;
                }
				if (TileMap.mapID == 28)
				{
					if (Char.myCharz().cx < TileMap.pxw / 2) UpdateXmap(29);
					else UpdateXmap(27);
					return;
                }
            }
		}
		UpdateXmap(IdMapEnd);
	}

	public void perform(int idAction, object p)
	{
		switch (idAction)
		{
		case 1:
			if(!isNRDMap(TileMap.mapID)) ShowPlanetMenu();
			else { ShowMapsMenu(planetDictionary.TryGetValue("Ngọc rồng\nsao đen", out var mapIDs) ? mapIDs : Array.Empty<int>()); }
			break;
		case 2:
			isEatChicken = !isEatChicken;
			GameScr.info1.addInfo("Ăn Đùi Gà\n" + (isEatChicken ? "[ON]" : "[OFF]"), 0);
			if (isSaveData)
			{
				Rms.saveRMSInt("AutoMapIsEatChicken", isEatChicken ? 1 : 0);
			}
			break;
		case 3:
			isHarvestPean = !isHarvestPean;
			GameScr.info1.addInfo("Thu Đậu\n" + (isHarvestPean ? "[ON]" : "[OFF]"), 0);
			if (isSaveData)
			{
				Rms.saveRMSInt("AutoMapIsHarvestPean", isHarvestPean ? 1 : 0);
			}
			break;
		case 4:
			isUseCapsule = !isUseCapsule;
			GameScr.info1.addInfo("Sử Dụng Capsule\n" + (isUseCapsule ? "[ON]" : "[OFF]"), 0);
			if (isSaveData)
			{
				Rms.saveRMSInt("AutoMapIsUseCsb", isUseCapsule ? 1 : 0);
			}
			break;
		case 5:
			//isSaveData = !isSaveData;
			//GameScr.info1.addInfo("Lưu Cài Đặt Auto Map\n" + (isSaveData ? "[ON]" : "[OFF]"), 0);
			//Rms.saveRMSInt("AutoMapIsSaveRms", isSaveData ? 1 : 0);
			//if (isSaveData)
			//{
			//	SaveData();
			//}
			break;
		case 6:
			ShowMapsMenu((int[])p);
			break;
		case 7:
			IdMapEnd = (int)p;
			if (!isNRDMap((int)p))
			{
				isXmaping = true;
				//GameScr.info1.addInfo("Go to " + TileMap.mapNames[IdMapEnd], 0);
			}
			else
			{
				MainMod.mapIdNRD = RequestMapnrsd((int)p);
                MainMod.isAutoEnterNRDMap = true;
                MainMod.isOpenMenuNPC = MainMod.isAutoEnterNRDMap;
                new Thread(new ThreadStart(MainMod.EnterNRDMap)).Start();
            }
			break;
		}
	}

    private static void UpdateXmap(int mapID)
	{
        int[] array = FindWay(mapID);
        if (array == null)
		{
            array=FindWayNull(mapID);
            if (array == null) return;
		}
        if (isUseCapsule)
		{
			if (!isUsingCapsule && array.Length >2)
			{
				for (int i = 0; i < Char.myCharz().arrItemBag.Length; i++)
				{
					Item item = Char.myCharz().arrItemBag[i];
					if (item != null && (item.template.id == 194 || (item.template.id == 193 && item.quantity > 10)))
					{
						isUsingCapsule = true;
						isOpeningPanel = false;
						lastTimeOpenedPanel = mSystem.currentTimeMillis();
						if(GameCanvas.panel.mapNames != null) GameCanvas.panel.mapNames = null;
						Service.gI().useItem(0, 1, -1, item.template.id);
						return;
					}
				}
			}

            if (isUsingCapsule && !isOpeningPanel && (GameCanvas.panel.mapNames == null || mSystem.currentTimeMillis() - lastTimeOpenedPanel < 1000L)) return;
            if (isUsingCapsule && !isOpeningPanel)
			{
                for (int num = array.Length - 1; num >= 1; num--)
				{
					for (int j = 0; j < GameCanvas.panel.mapNames.Length; j++)
					{
                        if (GameCanvas.panel.mapNames[j].Replace("Về chỗ cũ: ", "").Contains(NamePlane(array[num])))
						{
							lastTimeOpenedPanel = mSystem.currentTimeMillis();
                            isUsingCapsule = false;
                            Service.gI().requestMapSelect(j);
							return;
                        }
					}
                    if (TileMap.mapID == array[num])
                    {
                        isOpeningPanel = true;
                        isUsingCapsule = false;
                    }
                }
            }
		}
        if (TileMap.mapID == array[0] && !Char.ischangingMap && !Controller.isStopReadMessage)
		{
            Goto(array[1]);
		}
	}
