	private static void AddLinkMapsXmap(params int[] link)
	{
		for (int i = 0; i < link.Length; i++)
		{
			if (!linkMaps.ContainsKey(link[i]))
			{
				linkMaps.Add(link[i], new List<NextMap>());
			}
			if (i != 0)
			{
				linkMaps[link[i]].Add(new NextMap(link[i - 1], -1, new int[] { -1 }, Type.next_move, null));
			}
			if (i != link.Length - 1)
			{
				linkMaps[link[i]].Add(new NextMap(link[i + 1], -1, new int[] { -1 }, Type.next_move, null));
			}
		}
	}

    private static void AddCoordinateLinkMapsXmap(int mapA, int mapB, int fwX, int fwY, int bwX, int bwY)
    {
        // 1. Tạo liên kết đi xuôi (Forward): từ mapA -> mapB dùng tọa độ fw
        if (!linkMaps.ContainsKey(mapA))
        {
            linkMaps.Add(mapA, new List<NextMap>());
        }
        // Thay new int[] { -1 } bằng tọa độ fwX, fwY
        linkMaps[mapA].Add(new NextMap(mapB, -1, new int[] { -1 }, Type.moveto, new object[] { fwX, fwY }));

        // 2. Tạo liên kết đi ngược (Backward): từ mapB -> mapA dùng tọa độ bw
        if (!linkMaps.ContainsKey(mapB))
        {
            linkMaps.Add(mapB, new List<NextMap>());
        }
        // Thay new int[] { -1 } bằng tọa độ bwX, bwY
        linkMaps[mapB].Add(new NextMap(mapA, -1, new int[] { -1 }, Type.moveto, new object[] { bwX, bwY }));
    }

    private static void AddNPCLinkMapsXmap(int currentMapID, int nextMapID, int npcID, int[] select,string captions)
	{
		if (!linkMaps.ContainsKey(currentMapID))
		{
			linkMaps.Add(currentMapID, new List<NextMap>());
		}
		linkMaps[currentMapID].Add(new NextMap(nextMapID, npcID, select,Type.npc_move, new object[] { captions }));
	}

    private static void AddLinkMapsUseItemXmap(int nextMapID, int IDitem)
	{
        if (!linkMaps.ContainsKey(-1))
        {
            linkMaps.Add(-1, new List<NextMap>());
        }
        linkMaps[-1].Add(new NextMap(nextMapID, -1, new int[] {-1}, Type.useitem_move, new object[] { IDitem }));
    }

	private static void Goto(int mapID)
	{
        if (!linkMaps.ContainsKey(TileMap.mapID))
        {
            GameScr.info1.addInfo("Không có đường đi từ map hiện tại", 0);
            return;
        }
        foreach (NextMap item in linkMaps[TileMap.mapID])
		{
			if (item.MapID == mapID)
			{
				item.GotoMap();
				return;
			}
		}
		GameScr.info1.addInfo("Không thể thực hiện", 0);
	}

	private static int[] FindWayNull(int mapIDEnd)
	{
		if (!isUsingCapsule)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < Char.myCharz().arrItemBag.Length; i++)
			{
				Item item = Char.myCharz().arrItemBag[i];
				if (item != null && (item.template.id == 194 || item.template.id == 193))
				{
					isUsingCapsule = true;
					isOpeningPanel = false;
					//lastTimeOpenedPanel = mSystem.currentTimeMillis();
					//GameCanvas.panel.mapNames = null;
					Service.gI().useItem(0, 1, -1, item.template.id);
					//if (Char.myCharz().statusMe == 14)
					//{
					//	isUsingCapsule = false;
					//	isOpeningPanel = true;
					//}
					break;
				}
			}
		}
		else if (!isOpeningPanel)
		{
			if (GameCanvas.panel.mapNames == null || mapNameLookup == null ) return null;
            // Chuyển danh sách tên từ Capsule sang ID thực tế
            List<int> startIDs = new List<int>();
            for (int j = 0; j < GameCanvas.panel.mapNames.Length; j++)
			{
                if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(GameCanvas.panel.mapNames[j])) continue;
                string cleanName = GameCanvas.panel.mapNames[j].Replace("Về chỗ cũ: ", "");
                if (mapNameLookup.TryGetValue(cleanName, out var ids))
				{
                    startIDs.AddRange(ids);
                }
			}
            // 3. Tìm đường từ toàn bộ danh sách ID này
            int[] finalPath = FindWay(mapIDEnd, startIDs.ToArray());
            for (int k = 0; k < GameCanvas.panel.mapNames.Length; k++)
            {
                if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(GameCanvas.panel.mapNames[k])) continue;
                string cleanName = GameCanvas.panel.mapNames[k].Replace("Về chỗ cũ: ", "");
                if (finalPath != null)
				{
					if(finalPath.Length > 0 && cleanName.Contains(NamePlane(finalPath[0])))
					{
                        isOpeningPanel = true;
                        isUsingCapsule = false;
                        Service.gI().requestMapSelect(k);
						return finalPath;
                    }
                }
				else
				{
                    if (cleanName.Contains(NamePlane(Char.myCharz().cgender+21)))
                    {
                        isOpeningPanel = true;
                        isUsingCapsule = false;
                        Service.gI().requestMapSelect(k);
                        return finalPath;
                    }
                }

            }
		}
        GameScr.info1.addInfo("Không thể tìm thấy đường đi", 0);
        return null;
	}
	private static int[] FindWay(int mapID)
	{
		return FindWay(mapID, new int[] { TileMap.mapID });
	}
    private static int[] FindWay(int mapIDEnd, int[] mapIDStarts)
    {
        if (mapIDStarts == null || mapIDStarts.Length == 0) return null;

        // Hàng đợi lưu trữ các con đường (List<int>)
        Queue<List<int>> queue = new Queue<List<int>>();

        // Tập hợp các map đã đi qua để tránh vòng lặp vô tận
        HashSet<int> visited = new HashSet<int>();
        // BƯỚC 1: Khởi tạo - Đưa tất cả điểm xuất phát vào Queue
        foreach (int startID in mapIDStarts)
        {
            if (startID == mapIDEnd) return new int[] { startID };

            queue.Enqueue(new List<int> { startID });
            visited.Add(startID);
        }
        while (queue.Count > 0)
        {
            List<int> currentPath = queue.Dequeue();
            int lastMap = currentPath[currentPath.Count - 1];

            // Duyệt các map kế cận
            if (!linkMaps.ContainsKey(lastMap)) continue;

            foreach (NextMap next in linkMaps[lastMap])
            {
                if (visited.Contains(next.MapID)) continue;

                List<int> newPath = new List<int>(currentPath) { next.MapID };

                // Kiểm tra các điều kiện đặc thù của game nro
                if (hasWayGoFutureAndBack(newPath.ToArray()) ||
                   (Char.myCharz().taskMaint.taskId <= 30 && hasWayGoToColdMap(newPath.ToArray())))
                    continue;

                if (next.MapID == mapIDEnd)
                    return newPath.ToArray();

                visited.Add(next.MapID);
                queue.Enqueue(newPath);
            }
        }
        return null;
    }

    private static bool hasWayGoFutureAndBack(int[] ways)
	{
		for (int i = 1; i < ways.Length - 1; i++)
		{
			if (ways[i] == 102 && ways[i + 1] == 24 && (ways[i - 1] == 27 || ways[i - 1] == 28 || ways[i - 1] == 29))
			{
				return true;
			}
		}
		return false;
	}

	private static bool hasWayGoToColdMap(int[] ways)
	{
		for (int i = 0; i < ways.Length; i++)
		{
			if (ways[i] >= 105 && ways[i] <= 110)
			{
				return true;
			}
		}
		return false;
	}

	private static string GetMapName(int mapID)
	{
		if (1 == 0)
		{
		}
		string result = mapID switch
		{
			113 => string.Concat(new object[3] { "Siêu hạng\n[", mapID, "]" }),
			129 => TileMap.mapNames[mapID] + " 23\n[" + mapID + "]",
			_ => TileMap.mapNames[mapID] + "\n[" + mapID + "]",
		};
		if (1 == 0)
		{
		}
		return result;
	}

	private static void LoadWaypointsInMap()
	{
		ResetSavedWaypoints();
		int num = TileMap.vGo.size();
		if (num != 2)
		{
			for (int i = 0; i < num; i++)
			{
				Waypoint waypoint = (Waypoint)TileMap.vGo.elementAt(i);
				bool specical = TileMap.mapID==155;

				if (waypoint.maxX < 60)
				{
                    wayPointMapLeft[0] = waypoint.minX + 15;
					wayPointMapLeft[1] = waypoint.maxY;
				}
				else if (waypoint.maxX > TileMap.pxw - 60)
				{
                    wayPointMapRight[0] = waypoint.maxX - 15;
					wayPointMapRight[1] = waypoint.maxY-(specical?24:0);
				}
				else
				{
                    wayPointMapCenter[0] = waypoint.minX + 15;
					wayPointMapCenter[1] = waypoint.maxY;
				}
			}
			return;
		}

        Waypoint waypoint2 = (Waypoint)TileMap.vGo.elementAt(0);
		Waypoint waypoint3 = (Waypoint)TileMap.vGo.elementAt(1);
		if ((waypoint2.maxX < 60 && waypoint3.maxX < 60) || (waypoint2.minX > TileMap.pxw - 60 && waypoint3.minX > TileMap.pxw - 60))
		{
			wayPointMapLeft[0] = waypoint2.minX + 15;
			wayPointMapLeft[1] = waypoint2.maxY;
			wayPointMapRight[0] = waypoint3.maxX - 15;
			wayPointMapRight[1] = waypoint3.maxY;
		}
		else if (waypoint2.maxX < waypoint3.maxX)
		{
			wayPointMapLeft[0] = waypoint2.minX + 15;
			wayPointMapLeft[1] = waypoint2.maxY;
			wayPointMapRight[0] = waypoint3.maxX - 15;
			wayPointMapRight[1] = waypoint3.maxY;
		}
		else
		{
			wayPointMapLeft[0] = waypoint3.minX + 15;
			wayPointMapLeft[1] = waypoint3.maxY;
			wayPointMapRight[0] = waypoint2.maxX - 15;
			wayPointMapRight[1] = waypoint2.maxY;
		}
	}

	public static int GetYGround(int x)
	{
		int num = 50;
		int num2 = 0;
		while (num2 < 30)
		{
			num2++;
			num += 24;
			if (TileMap.tileTypeAt(x, num, 2))
			{
				if (num % 24 != 0)
				{
					num -= num % 24;
				}
				break;
			}
		}
		return num;
	}

	public static void TeleportTo(int x, int y)
	{
        if (Char.myCharz().isLockMove && Char.myCharz().npcFocus == null)
        {
            GameScr.info1.addInfo("Đang không thể di chuyển!", 0);
            return;
        }
		Char.myCharz().cx = x;
		Char.myCharz().cy = y;
		Service.gI().charMove();
        if (!GameScr.canAutoPlay)
        {
            Char.myCharz().cx = x;
            Char.myCharz().cy = y + 1;
            Service.gI().charMove();
            Char.myCharz().cx = x;
            Char.myCharz().cy = y;
            Service.gI().charMove();
        }
    }

	private static void ResetSavedWaypoints()
	{
		wayPointMapLeft = new int[2];
		wayPointMapCenter = new int[2];
		wayPointMapRight = new int[2];
	}

	private static bool isNRDMap(int MapID)
	{
		if (MapID >= 85)
		{
			return MapID <= 91;
		}
		return false;
	}

	private static bool isFutureMap(int mapID)
	{
		for (int i = 0; i < idMapsTuongLai.Length; i++)
		{
			if (idMapsTuongLai[i] == mapID)
			{
				return true;
			}
		}
		return false;
	}

	private static bool itemNRD(ItemMap mapID)
	{
		if (mapID.template.id >= 372)
		{
			return mapID.template.id <= 378;
		}
		return false;
	}

	private static void LoadMap(int position)
	{
		if (isNRDMap(TileMap.mapID))
		{
			TeleportInNRDMap(position);
			return;
		}
		LoadWaypointsInMap();
		switch (position)
		{
		case 0:
			if (wayPointMapLeft[0] != 0 && wayPointMapLeft[1] != 0)
			{
				TeleportTo(wayPointMapLeft[0], wayPointMapLeft[1]);
			}
			else
			{
				TeleportTo(60, GetYGround(60));
			}
			break;
		case 1:
			if (wayPointMapRight[0] != 0 && wayPointMapRight[1] != 0)
			{
				TeleportTo(wayPointMapRight[0], wayPointMapRight[1]);
			}
			else
			{
				TeleportTo(TileMap.pxw - 60, GetYGround(TileMap.pxw - 60));
			}
			break;
		case 2:
			if (wayPointMapCenter[0] != 0 && wayPointMapCenter[1] != 0)
			{
				TeleportTo(wayPointMapCenter[0], wayPointMapCenter[1]);
			}
			else
			{
				TeleportTo(TileMap.pxw / 2, GetYGround(TileMap.pxw / 2));
			}
			break;
		}
		if (TileMap.mapID != 7 && TileMap.mapID != 14 && TileMap.mapID != 0)
		{
			Service.gI().requestChangeMap();
			return;
        }
		Service.gI().getMapOffline();
	}

	private static void TeleportInNRDMap(int position)
	{

		switch (position)
		{
			case 0:
				TeleportTo(60, GetYGround(60));
				break;
			case 1:
				TeleportTo(TileMap.pxw - 60, GetYGround(TileMap.pxw - 60));
				break;
			case 2:
				for (int i = 0; i < GameScr.vItemMap.size(); i++)
				{
					ItemMap itemMap = (ItemMap)GameScr.vItemMap.elementAt(i);
					if (itemNRD(itemMap))
					{
						TeleportTo(itemMap.x, itemMap.y - 3);
						break;
					}
				}
				for (int j = 0; j < GameScr.vNpc.size(); j++)
				{
					Npc npc = (Npc)GameScr.vNpc.elementAt(j);
					if (npc.template.npcTemplateId >= 30 && npc.template.npcTemplateId <= 36)
					{
						TeleportTo(npc.cx, npc.cy - 3);
						break;
					}
				}
				break;
			default: break;
		}
	}

	static AutoMap()
	{
        LongWaitNextMap = 2000L;
        linkMaps = new Dictionary<int, List<NextMap>>();
		planetDictionary = new Dictionary<string, int[]>();
		isEatChicken = true;
		isUseCapsule = true;
		idMapsTuongLai = new int[10] { 102, 92, 93, 94, 96, 97, 98, 99, 100, 103 };
		InitializeXmap(Path.Combine(AppDomain.CurrentDomain.BaseDirectory, "Resources", "map_data.json"));
        LoadData();
		AddLinkMapOnly();
    }

    public static sbyte FindCT(int id)
	{
		for (int i = 0; i < Char.myCharz().arrItemBag.Length; i++)
		{
			if (Char.myCharz().arrItemBag[i] != null && Char.myCharz().arrItemBag[i].template.id ==id)
			{
				return (sbyte)i;
			}
		}
		return -1;
	}

    public static void TeleVip(int CharID)
	{
		if (isteleport)
		{
			isteleport = false;
			return;
		}
        isteleport = true;
        Item[] arrItemBody = Char.myCharz().arrItemBody;
        if (FindCT(592+Char.myCharz().cgender) == -1 && (!arrItemBody[5].template.name.Contains("Yardrat") || arrItemBody[5] == null))
		{
            GameScr.info1.addInfo("Không tìm thấy Yardat!", 0);
            isteleport = false;
            return;
        }
		if (!global::Char.ischangingMap && !Controller.isStopReadMessage)
		{
			sbyte idYD = FindCT(592 + Char.myCharz().cgender);
            if (arrItemBody[5] == null)
            {
                GameScr.info1.addInfo("Đang mặc yardat", 0);
                Service.gI().getItem(4, idYD);
                Service.gI().gotoPlayer(CharID);
                isteleport = false;
                return;
            }
            if (!arrItemBody[5].template.name.Contains("Yardrat"))
			{
                GameScr.info1.addInfo("Đang mặc yardat", 0);
                Service.gI().getItem(4, idYD);
                Service.gI().gotoPlayer(CharID);
                Service.gI().getItem(4, idYD);
                isteleport = false;
                return;
            }
            Service.gI().gotoPlayer(CharID);
        }
        isteleport = false;
    }

	private static int RequestMapnrsd(int p)
	{
        switch (p)
        {
            case 85:
                return 1;
            case 86:
                return 2;
            case 87:
                return 3;
            case 88:
                return 4;
            case 89:
                return 5;
            case 90:
                return 6;
            case 91:
                return 7;
            default:
                MainMod.isAutoEnterNRDMap = false;
                MainMod.isOpenMenuNPC = MainMod.isAutoEnterNRDMap;
                return -1;
        }
    }
    public static void InitMapLookup(string name, int id)
    {
        mapNameLookup.Clear();
        if (!mapNameLookup.ContainsKey(name))
		{
            mapNameLookup[name] = new List<int>();
            mapNameLookup[name].Add(id);
        }
    }
	private static void InitializeXmap(string jsonPath)
	{
		try
		{
			string jsonContent = File.ReadAllText(jsonPath);
			MapData data = JsonSerializer.Deserialize(jsonContent, AppConfigJsonContext.Default.MapData);
			if (data == null) return;

			//0.
			if (data.coordinate_maps != null)
			{
				foreach (var entry in data.coordinate_maps)
				{
					AddCoordinateLinkMapsXmap(
						entry.map[0],
						entry.map[1],
						entry.fw.cx,
						entry.fw.cy,
						entry.bw.cx,
						entry.bw.cy
					);
				}
			}
			// 1. Xử lý link_maps (Các map thông nhau trực tiếp)
			if (data.link_maps != null)
			{
				foreach (var link in data.link_maps)
				{
					AddLinkMapsXmap(link);
				}
			}

			// 2. Xử lý npc_maps (Chuyển map qua NPC)
			if (data.npc_maps != null)
			{
				foreach (var nMap in data.npc_maps)
				{
					int mapStart = nMap.map[0];
					int mapEnd = nMap.map[1];

					if (nMap.fw != null) AddNPCLinkMapsXmap(mapStart, mapEnd, nMap.fw.npcId, nMap.fw.selectIndex, nMap.fw.captions);

					if (nMap.bw != null) AddNPCLinkMapsXmap(mapEnd, mapStart, nMap.bw.npcId, nMap.bw.selectIndex, nMap.fw.captions);
				}
			}
			// 3. Xử lý useitem_maps (Sử dụng vật phẩm để bay/chuyển map)
			if (data.useitem_maps != null)
			{
				foreach (var iMap in data.useitem_maps)
				{
					foreach (int startMap in iMap.map)
					{
						if (iMap.fw != null) AddLinkMapsUseItemXmap(startMap, iMap.fw.itemId);
						if (iMap.bw != null) AddLinkMapsUseItemXmap(startMap, iMap.bw.itemId);
					}
				}
			}

			//4. Xử lý thêm item menu
			if (data.menu_maps != null)
			{
				foreach (var MenuMap in data.menu_maps)
				{
					planetDictionary.Add(MenuMap.menu, MenuMap.IDmap);
				}
			}
		}
		catch (Exception ex)
		{
			//Console.WriteLine("Error loading map data: " + ex.Message);
		}
	}
}

		{

					int num = (maximumPickDistance = int.Parse(ChatTextField.gI().tfChat.getText()));

	public void perform(int idAction, object p)
	{
		switch (idAction)
		{
		case 1:
			isAutoPick = !isAutoPick;
			pickByList = 0;
			GameScr.info1.addInfo("Auto Nhặt\n" + (isAutoPick ? "[ON]" : "[OFF]"), 0);
			break;
		case 2:
            isAutoPick = !isAutoPick;
            pickByList = 3;
            GameScr.info1.addInfo("Nhặt Tất Cả\n" + (isAutoPick ? "[ON]" : "[OFF]"), 0);
			break;
		case 3:
			isAutoPick = !isAutoPick;
			pickByList = 1;
			GameScr.info1.addInfo("Nhặt Theo Danh Sách\n" + (isAutoPick ? "[ON]" : "[OFF]"), 0);
			break;
		case 4:

			ChatTextField.gI().tfChat.name = inputMaximumPickDistance[1];
			ChatTextField.gI().startChat2(getInstance(), string.Empty);

		case 6:

			if (listItemAutoPick.Count > 0)

	public static void FocusToNearestItem()
	{
		for (int i = 0; i < GameScr.vItemMap.size(); i++)
		{
			ItemMap itemMap = (ItemMap)GameScr.vItemMap.elementAt(i);
			int num = Math.abs(Char.myCharz().cx - itemMap.x);
			int num2 = Math.abs(Char.myCharz().cy - itemMap.y);
			if (num <= maximumPickDistance && num2 <= maximumPickDistance && isPickIt(itemMap) && itemMap.template.id != 673)
			{
				if (Char.myCharz().itemFocus != itemMap)
				{
					Char.myCharz().itemFocus = itemMap;
                }
            }
		}
	}

	{

		{
			return;

        int num = Math.abs(Char.myCharz().cx - Char.myCharz().itemFocus.x);
        int num2 = Math.abs(Char.myCharz().cy - Char.myCharz().itemFocus.y);
        if (isTeleportToItem && !Char.isLockKey)
		{
            if (Math.abs(Char.myCharz().itemFocus.x - Char.myCharz().cx) > 60)
			{
				TeleportTo(Char.myCharz().itemFocus.x, MainMod.GetYGround(Char.myCharz().itemFocus.x));
			}
            if (Char.myCharz().cx < Char.myCharz().itemFocus.x)
            {
                Char.myCharz().cdir = 1;
            }
            else
            {
                Char.myCharz().cdir = -1;
            }

            if (num <= 60 && num2 < 60)
            {
                GameCanvas.clearKeyHold();
                GameCanvas.clearKeyPressed();
                if (Char.myCharz().itemFocus.template.id != 673)
                {
                    lastTimePickedItem = mSystem.currentTimeMillis();
                    Service.gI().pickItem(Char.myCharz().itemFocus.itemMapID);
                }
            }
			return;
        }
		if (Char.myCharz().cx < Char.myCharz().itemFocus.x)
		{
			Char.myCharz().cdir = 1;
		}
		else
		{
			Char.myCharz().cdir = -1;
		}
		if (num <= 60 && num2 < 60)
		{
			GameCanvas.clearKeyHold();
			GameCanvas.clearKeyPressed();
			if (Char.myCharz().itemFocus.template.id != 673)
			{
                lastTimePickedItem = mSystem.currentTimeMillis();
                Service.gI().pickItem(Char.myCharz().itemFocus.itemMapID);
			}
		}
		else
		{
			Char.myCharz().currentMovePoint = new MovePoint(Char.myCharz().itemFocus.x, Char.myCharz().itemFocus.y);
			Char.myCharz().endMovePointCommand = new Command(null, null, 8002, null);

	public static void TeleportTo(int x, int y)
	{
        if (Char.myCharz().isLockMove && Char.myCharz().npcFocus == null)
        {
            GameScr.info1.addInfo("Đang không thể di chuyển!", 0);
            return;
		}
		Char.myCharz().cx = x;
		Char.myCharz().cy = y;
		Service.gI().charMove();
        Char.myCharz().cx = x;
		Char.myCharz().cy = y + 1;
		Service.gI().charMove();
		Char.myCharz().cx = x;
		Char.myCharz().cy = y;
		Service.gI().charMove();
	}
	public static void PickVip()
	{
		if (Char.myCharz().itemFocus == null || (Char.myCharz().itemFocus != null && !isNRD(Char.myCharz().itemFocus)))
		{
			int count = GameScr.vItemMap.size();
			for (int i = 0; i < count; i++)
			{
				ItemMap itemMap = (ItemMap)GameScr.vItemMap.elementAt(i);
				if (itemMap != null && isNRD(itemMap))
				{
					Char.myCharz().charFocus = null;
					Char.myCharz().mobFocus = null;
					Char.myCharz().npcFocus = null;
					Char.myCharz().itemFocus = itemMap;
					break;
				}
			}
		}
        if (Char.myCharz().itemFocus != null && isNRD(Char.myCharz().itemFocus))
        {
            int num = Math.abs(Char.myCharz().cx - Char.myCharz().itemFocus.x);
            int num2 = Math.abs(Char.myCharz().cy - Char.myCharz().itemFocus.y);
            if ((num > 60 || num2 > 60))
            {
                if (DateTimeOffset.UtcNow.ToUnixTimeMilliseconds() - LastTimeTeleToItem > 300L)
                {
                    TeleportTo(Char.myCharz().itemFocus.x, Char.myCharz().itemFocus.y);
                    //GameCanvas.clearKeyHold();
                    //GameCanvas.clearKeyPressed();
                    Service.gI().pickItem(Char.myCharz().itemFocus.itemMapID);
                    LastTimeTeleToItem = DateTimeOffset.UtcNow.ToUnixTimeMilliseconds();
                }
            }
            else if (DateTimeOffset.UtcNow.ToUnixTimeMilliseconds() - lastTimePickedItem >= DelayPickItem)
            {
                //GameCanvas.clearKeyHold();
                //GameCanvas.clearKeyPressed();
                Service.gI().pickItem(Char.myCharz().itemFocus.itemMapID);
            }
        }
    }
	public static bool isPickIt(ItemMap item)
	{
		int type = TypePick();
        if (type == 0)
		{
			return false;
		}
		if (type == 1)
		{
			if (item.playerId != Char.myCharz().charID)
			{
				return item.playerId == -1;
			}
			return true;
		}
		if (type == 2 && MainMod.CurrentSetting.ListItem.Contains(item.template.id))
		{
			if (item.playerId != Char.myCharz().charID)
			{
				return item.playerId == -1;
			}
			return true;
		}
		return false;
	}
    private static int TypePick()
    {
        var type = MainMod.CurrentSetting.PickItemType;

		return type switch
		{
			AccountSetting.TypePickItem.NotPick => 0,
			AccountSetting.TypePickItem.PickAll => 1,
			AccountSetting.TypePickItem.PickIndex => 2,
			_ => 0,
		};
    }
    public static bool isNRDMap()
	{
        return TileMap.mapID >= 85 && TileMap.mapID <= 91;
    }

	public static bool isNRD(ItemMap item)
	{
		if (item.template.id >= 372)
		{
			return item.template.id <= 378;
		}
		return false;
	}

    public static bool TryFixItemPosition(int x, int y, out int validX, out int validY)
    {
        // Mặc định trả về tọa độ gốc
        validX = x;
        validY = y;
        // Bước 1: Kiểm tra xem vị trí hiện tại có phải vật cản không
        // Nếu không phải vật cản (false), trả về kết quả ngay lập tức
        if (!AutoTrain.isTileTypeMap(x, y))
        {
            return true;
        }
        // Bước 2: Quét 8 vị trí xung quanh với bước nhảy 60
        // Thứ tự quét: Ưu tiên 4 hướng thẳng (ngang/dọc) trước, 4 hướng chéo sau
        // vì trong cấu trúc map, hướng thẳng thường có xác suất trống cao hơn.
        if (!AutoTrain.isTileTypeMap(x - 60, y)) { validX = x - 60; return true; }
        if (!AutoTrain.isTileTypeMap(x + 60, y)) { validX = x + 60; return true; }
        if (!AutoTrain.isTileTypeMap(x, y - 60)) { validY = y - 60; return true; }
        if (!AutoTrain.isTileTypeMap(x, y + 60)) { validY = y + 60; return true; }

        // 5. Kiểm tra chéo: Trên-Trái
        if (!AutoTrain.isTileTypeMap(x - 60, y - 60)) { validX = x - 60; validY = y - 60; return true; }
        // 6. Kiểm tra chéo: Trên-Phải
        if (!AutoTrain.isTileTypeMap(x + 60, y - 60)) { validX = x + 60; validY = y - 60; return true; }
        // 7. Kiểm tra chéo: Dưới-Trái
        if (!AutoTrain.isTileTypeMap(x - 60, y + 60)) { validX = x - 60; validY = y + 60; return true; }
        // 8. Kiểm tra chéo: Dưới-Phải
        if (!AutoTrain.isTileTypeMap(x + 60, y + 60)) { validX = x + 60; validY = y + 60; return true; }

        // Không tìm thấy vị trí nào trống trong phạm vi 60
        return false;
    }

    static AutoPick()
	{
		maximumPickDistance = 60;
		listItemAutoPick = new List<int>();
		inputMaximumPickDistance = new string[2] { "Nhập khoảng cách nhặt", "khoảng cách (>50)" };
		inputItemID = new string[2] { "Nhập ID của item", "ID" };
	}
}

## File: rs/Mod/ProxyClient.cs
﻿using System;
using System.IO;
using System.Net.Sockets;
using System.Text;

namespace NRO;

public class ProxyClient
{
    public static string addressproxy;

    public static int postproxy;

    public static string accountproxy;

    public static string passproxy;

    public static bool HasProxy = false;
    public static TcpClient Connect(string targetHost, int targetPort)
    {
        string httpProxyHost = addressproxy;
        int httpProxyPort = postproxy;
        string proxyUserName = accountproxy;
        string proxyPassword = passproxy;
        TcpClient tcp = (HasProxy) ? null : new TcpClient(targetHost, targetPort);
        try
        {
            if (!HasProxy&&(string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(httpProxyHost) || httpProxyPort <= 0)) return new TcpClient(targetHost, targetPort);
            Uri uri = new UriBuilder
            {
                Scheme = Uri.UriSchemeHttp,
                Host = httpProxyHost,
                Port = httpProxyPort
            }.Uri;
            Uri uri2 = new UriBuilder
            {
                Scheme = Uri.UriSchemeHttp,
                Host = targetHost,
                Port = targetPort
            }.Uri;
            Socket socket = new Socket(AddressFamily.InterNetwork, SocketType.Stream, ProtocolType.Tcp);
            socket.Connect(httpProxyHost, httpProxyPort);
            StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder();
            sb.AppendFormat("CONNECT {0}:{1} HTTP/1.1\r\n", targetHost, targetPort);
            sb.AppendFormat("Host: {0}:{1}\r\n", targetHost, targetPort);

            // Xử lý xác thực Basic Auth nếu có
            if (!string.IsNullOrEmpty(proxyUserName) && !string.IsNullOrEmpty(proxyPassword))
            {
                string auth = Convert.ToBase64String(Encoding.ASCII.GetBytes($"{proxyUserName}:{proxyPassword}"));
                sb.AppendFormat("Proxy-Authorization: Basic {0}\r\n", auth);
            }

            sb.Append("Proxy-Connection: Keep-Alive\r\n");
            sb.Append("Connection: Keep-Alive\r\n");
            sb.Append("\r\n");
            socket.Send(Encoding.ASCII.GetBytes(sb.ToString()));
            byte[] buffer = new byte[1024];
            int received = socket.Receive(buffer);
            if (received <= 0) return tcp;
            string response = Encoding.ASCII.GetString(buffer, 0, received);
            if (!response.Contains("200"))
            {
                socket.Close();
                return tcp;
            }
            tcp = new TcpClient { Client = socket };
        }
        catch (Exception ex)
        {
            //Console.WriteLine("ex:" + ex.Message);
            return tcp;
        }
        return tcp;
    }
}

using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.IO;

namespace NRO;

public class AutoChat : IActionListener, IChatable
{
	private static AutoChat _Instance;

	private static bool isAutoChatPublic;

	private static long delayAutoChatPublic;

	private static long lastTimeChatPublic;

	private static string autoChatPublicContent;

	private static bool isAutoChatGlobal;

	private static long delayAutoChatGlobal;

	private static long lastTimeChatGlobal;

	private static string autoChatGlobalContent;

	private static int countChatGlobal;

	private static int gems;

	private static bool isAutoSpamChatGlobal;

	private static int spammedChatGlobalTimes;

	private static int timesSpamChatGlobal;

	public static bool isAutoInbox;

	public static List<int> listCharInbox;

	private static string autoInboxContent;

	private static long lastTimeInbox;

	private static int countChatInbox;

	private static bool isSaveData;

	private static string[] inputDelayChatPublic;

	private static string[] inputDelayChatGlobal;

	private static string[] inputSpamChatGlobal;

	public static AutoChat getInstance()
	{
		if (_Instance == null)
		{
			_Instance = new AutoChat();
		}
		return _Instance;
	}

	public static void Update()
	{
		if (isAutoChatPublic)
		{
			ChatPublic();
		}
		if (isAutoChatGlobal)
		{
			ChatGlobal();
		}
		if (isAutoSpamChatGlobal)
		{
			SpamChatGlobal();
		}
		if (isAutoInbox)
		{
			ChatInbox();
		}
	}

	public void onChatFromMe(string text, string to)
	{
		if (ChatTextField.gI().tfChat.getText() != null && !ChatTextField.gI().tfChat.getText().Equals(string.Empty) && !text.Equals(string.Empty) && text != null)
		{
			if (ChatTextField.gI().strChat.Equals(inputDelayChatPublic[0]))
			{
				int num = 0;
				try
				{
					num = int.Parse(ChatTextField.gI().tfChat.getText());
					if (num > 0)
					{
						try
						{
							autoChatPublicContent = File.ReadAllText("Data\\TextChatPublic.ini");
							delayAutoChatPublic = num;
							isAutoChatPublic = true;
							GameScr.info1.addInfo("Auto Chat: " + ((delayAutoChatPublic >= 5000) ? NinjaUtil.getMoneys(delayAutoChatPublic) : "5.000") + " mili giây", 0);
							if (isSaveData)
							{
								Rms.saveRMSInt("AutoChatIsAutoChatPublic", 1);
								Rms.saveRMSString("AutoChatDelayChatPublic", delayAutoChatPublic.ToString());
							}
						}
						catch
						{
							GameScr.info1.addInfo("Lỗi đọc File!", 0);
						}
					}
					if (num <= 0)
					{
						GameCanvas.startOKDlg("Delay không hợp lệ!");
					}
				}
				catch
				{
					GameCanvas.startOKDlg("Delay không hợp lệ!");
				}
				ResetChatTextField();
			}
			else if (ChatTextField.gI().strChat.Equals(inputDelayChatGlobal[0]))
			{
				int num2 = 0;
				try
				{
					num2 = int.Parse(ChatTextField.gI().tfChat.getText());
					if (num2 > 0)
					{
						try
						{
							autoChatGlobalContent = File.ReadAllText("Data\\TextChatGlobal.ini");
							delayAutoChatGlobal = num2;
							isAutoChatGlobal = true;
							isAutoSpamChatGlobal = false;
							GameScr.info1.addInfo("Auto Chat Thế Giới: " + NinjaUtil.getMoneys(delayAutoChatGlobal) + " mili giây", 0);
							if (isSaveData)
							{
								Rms.saveRMSInt("AutoChatIsAutoChatGlobal", 1);
								Rms.saveRMSString("AutoChatDelayChatGlobal", delayAutoChatGlobal.ToString());
							}
						}
						catch
						{
							GameScr.info1.addInfo("Lỗi đọc File!", 0);
						}
					}
					if (num2 <= 0)
					{
						GameCanvas.startOKDlg("Delay không hợp lệ!");
					}
				}
				catch
				{
					GameCanvas.startOKDlg("Delay không hợp lệ!");
				}
				ResetChatTextField();
			}
			else
			{
				if (!ChatTextField.gI().strChat.Equals(inputSpamChatGlobal[0]))
				{
					return;
				}
				int num3 = 0;
				try
				{
					num3 = int.Parse(ChatTextField.gI().tfChat.getText());
					if (num3 > 0)
					{
						try
						{
							autoChatGlobalContent = File.ReadAllText("Data\\TextChatGlobal.ini");
							timesSpamChatGlobal = num3;
							spammedChatGlobalTimes = 0;
							gems = Char.myCharz().luong + Char.myCharz().luongKhoa;
							isAutoChatGlobal = false;
							isAutoSpamChatGlobal = true;
							GameScr.info1.addInfo("Spam Chat Thế Giới: " + timesSpamChatGlobal + " lần", 0);
						}
						catch
						{
							GameScr.info1.addInfo("Lỗi đọc File!", 0);
						}
					}
					if (num3 <= 0)
					{
						GameCanvas.startOKDlg("Số lần không hợp lệ!");
					}
				}
				catch
				{
					GameCanvas.startOKDlg("Số lần không hợp lệ!");
				}
				ResetChatTextField();
			}
		}
		else
		{
			ChatTextField.gI().isShow = false;
			ResetChatTextField();
		}
	}

	public void onCancelChat()
	{
	}

	public void perform(int idAction, object p)
	{
		switch (idAction)
		{
		case 1:
			if (!isAutoChatPublic)
			{
				ChatTextField.gI().strChat = inputDelayChatPublic[0];
				ChatTextField.gI().tfChat.name = inputDelayChatPublic[1];
				ChatTextField.gI().startChat2(getInstance(), string.Empty);
			}
			if (isAutoChatPublic)
			{
				isAutoChatPublic = false;
				GameScr.info1.addInfo("Auto Chat\n[OFF]", 0);
				if (isSaveData)
				{
					Rms.saveRMSInt("AutoChatIsAutoChatPublic", 0);
				}
			}
			break;
		case 2:
			if (!isAutoChatGlobal)
			{
				ChatTextField.gI().strChat = inputDelayChatGlobal[0];
				ChatTextField.gI().tfChat.name = inputDelayChatGlobal[1];
				ChatTextField.gI().startChat2(getInstance(), string.Empty);
			}
			if (isAutoChatGlobal)
			{
				isAutoChatGlobal = false;
				GameScr.info1.addInfo("Auto Chat Thế Giới\n[OFF]", 0);
				if (isSaveData)
				{
					Rms.saveRMSInt("AutoChatIsAutoChatGlobal", 0);
				}
			}
			break;
		case 3:
			if (!isAutoSpamChatGlobal)
			{
				ChatTextField.gI().strChat = inputSpamChatGlobal[0];
				ChatTextField.gI().tfChat.name = inputSpamChatGlobal[1];
				ChatTextField.gI().startChat2(getInstance(), string.Empty);
			}
			if (isAutoSpamChatGlobal)
			{
				isAutoSpamChatGlobal = false;
				GameScr.info1.addInfo("Auto Spam Chat Thế Giới\n[OFF]", 0);
			}
			break;
		case 4:
			if (isAutoInbox)
			{
				isAutoInbox = false;
				GameScr.info1.addInfo("Auto Inbox\n[OFF]", 0);
			}
			else
			{
				try
				{
					autoInboxContent = File.ReadAllText("Data\\TextChatInbox.ini");
					isAutoInbox = true;
					GameScr.info1.addInfo("Auto Inbox\n[ON]", 0);
				}
				catch
				{
					GameScr.info1.addInfo("Lỗi đọc File!", 0);
				}
			}
			if (isSaveData)
			{
				Rms.saveRMSInt("AutoChatIsAutoChatInbox", isAutoInbox ? 1 : 0);
			}
			break;
		case 5:
			isSaveData = !isSaveData;
			GameScr.info1.addInfo("Lưu Cài Đặt\n" + (isSaveData ? "[ON]" : "[OFF]"), 0);
			Rms.saveRMSInt("AutoChatIsSaveRms", isSaveData ? 1 : 0);
			if (isSaveData)
			{
				SaveData();
			}
			break;
		}
	}

	public static void ShowMenu()
	{
		LoadSavedData();
		MyVector myVector = new MyVector();
		myVector.addElement(new Command("Auto Chat\n" + (isAutoChatPublic ? ("[" + NinjaUtil.getMoneys(delayAutoChatPublic) + " mili giây]") : "[OFF]"), getInstance(), 1, null));
		myVector.addElement(new Command("Auto Chat Thế Giới\n" + (isAutoChatGlobal ? ("[" + NinjaUtil.getMoneys(delayAutoChatGlobal) + " mili giây]") : "[OFF]"), getInstance(), 2, null));
		myVector.addElement(new Command("Auto Spam Chat Thế Giới\n" + (isAutoSpamChatGlobal ? ("[" + spammedChatGlobalTimes + "/" + timesSpamChatGlobal + "]") : "[OFF]"), getInstance(), 3, null));
		myVector.addElement(new Command("Auto Inbox\n" + (isAutoInbox ? "[ON]" : "[OFF]"), getInstance(), 4, null));
		myVector.addElement(new Command("Lưu Cài Đặt\n" + (isSaveData ? "[ON]" : "[OFF]"), getInstance(), 5, null));
		GameCanvas.menu.startAt(myVector, 3);
	}

	private static void ResetChatTextField()
	{
		ChatTextField.gI().strChat = "Chat";
		ChatTextField.gI().tfChat.name = "chat";
		ChatTextField.gI().isShow = false;
	}

	private static void LoadSavedData()
	{
		isSaveData = Rms.loadRMSInt("AutoChatIsSaveRms") == 1;
		if (isSaveData)
		{
			isAutoChatPublic = Rms.loadRMSInt("AutoChatIsAutoChatPublic") == 1;
			isAutoChatGlobal = Rms.loadRMSInt("AutoChatIsAutoChatGlobal") == 1;
			isAutoInbox = Rms.loadRMSInt("AutoChatIsAutoChatInbox") == 1;
			if (isAutoChatPublic)
			{
				delayAutoChatPublic = long.Parse(Rms.loadRMSString("AutoChatDelayChatPublic"));
			}
			if (isAutoChatGlobal)
			{
				delayAutoChatGlobal = long.Parse(Rms.loadRMSString("AutoChatDelayChatGlobal"));
			}
		}
	}

	private static void SaveData()
	{
		Rms.saveRMSInt("AutoChatIsAutoChatPublic", isAutoChatPublic ? 1 : 0);
		Rms.saveRMSInt("AutoChatIsAutoChatGlobal", isAutoChatGlobal ? 1 : 0);
		Rms.saveRMSInt("AutoChatIsAutoChatInbox", isAutoInbox ? 1 : 0);
		if (isAutoChatPublic)
		{
			Rms.saveRMSString("AutoChatDelayChatPublic", delayAutoChatPublic.ToString());
		}
		if (isAutoChatGlobal)
		{
			Rms.saveRMSString("AutoChatDelayChatGlobal", delayAutoChatGlobal.ToString());
		}
	}

	private static void ChatPublic()
	{
		if (delayAutoChatPublic < 5000)
		{
			delayAutoChatPublic = 5000L;
		}
		if (autoChatPublicContent == null || autoChatPublicContent.Equals(""))
		{
			try
			{
				autoChatPublicContent = File.ReadAllText("Data\\TextChatPublic.ini");
			}
			catch
			{
				autoChatPublicContent = "Huy đẹp trai không!";
			}
		}
		if (mSystem.currentTimeMillis() - lastTimeChatPublic > delayAutoChatPublic)
		{
			lastTimeChatPublic = mSystem.currentTimeMillis();
			Service.gI().chat("[" + Res.random(100, 999) + "] " + autoChatPublicContent);
		}
	}

	private static void ChatGlobal()
	{
		int num = Char.myCharz().luong + Char.myCharz().luongKhoa;
		if (num < 5)
		{
			isAutoChatGlobal = false;
			GameScr.info1.addInfo("Bạn không đủ ngọc để chat!", 0);
			return;
		}
		if (delayAutoChatGlobal <= 0)
		{
			delayAutoChatGlobal = 5000L;
		}
		if (autoChatGlobalContent == null || autoChatGlobalContent.Equals(""))
		{
			try
			{
				autoChatGlobalContent = File.ReadAllText("Data\\TextChatGlobal.ini");
			}
			catch
			{
				autoChatGlobalContent = "Huy đẹp trai không!";
            }
		}
		if (gems == num && mSystem.currentTimeMillis() - lastTimeChatGlobal > 1000)
		{
			lastTimeChatGlobal = mSystem.currentTimeMillis() - delayAutoChatGlobal - 500;
		}
		if (mSystem.currentTimeMillis() - lastTimeChatGlobal > delayAutoChatGlobal)
		{
			lastTimeChatGlobal = mSystem.currentTimeMillis();
			countChatGlobal++;
			gems = num;
			Service.gI().chatGlobal(countChatGlobal + autoChatGlobalContent + " " + Res.random(100000, 999999));
		}
	}

	private static void SpamChatGlobal()
	{
		int num = Char.myCharz().luong + Char.myCharz().luongKhoa;
		if (num < 5 || timesSpamChatGlobal <= 0 || spammedChatGlobalTimes >= timesSpamChatGlobal)
		{
			isAutoSpamChatGlobal = false;
		}
		if (autoChatGlobalContent == null || autoChatGlobalContent.Equals(""))
		{
			try
			{
				autoChatGlobalContent = File.ReadAllText("Data\\TextChatGlobal.ini");
			}
			catch
			{
				autoChatGlobalContent = "Huy đẹp trai không!";
            }
		}
		if (gems != num)
		{
			gems = num;
			spammedChatGlobalTimes++;
		}
		if (mSystem.currentTimeMillis() - lastTimeChatGlobal >= 150)
		{
			lastTimeChatGlobal = mSystem.currentTimeMillis();
			countChatGlobal++;
			gems = num;
			Service.gI().chatGlobal(countChatGlobal + ": " + autoChatGlobalContent + " " + Res.random(100000, 999999));
		}
	}

	private static void ChatInbox()
	{
		if (listCharInbox == null)
		{
			listCharInbox = new List<int>();
		}
		for (int i = 0; i < GameScr.vCharInMap.size(); i++)
		{
			Char @char = (Char)GameScr.vCharInMap.elementAt(i);
			if (isInboxable(@char) && !listCharInbox.Contains(@char.charID))
			{
				listCharInbox.Add(@char.charID);
			}
		}
		if (autoInboxContent == null || autoInboxContent.Equals(""))
		{
			try
			{
				autoInboxContent = File.ReadAllText("Data\\TextChatInbox.ini");
			}
			catch
			{
				autoInboxContent = null;
			}
		}
		if (listCharInbox.Count > 0 && mSystem.currentTimeMillis() - lastTimeInbox > 2000)
		{
			lastTimeInbox = mSystem.currentTimeMillis();
			countChatInbox++;
			Service.gI().chatPlayer(countChatInbox + autoInboxContent + " " + Res.random(100000, 999999), listCharInbox[0]);
			listCharInbox.RemoveAt(0);
		}
	}

	private static bool isInboxable(Char ch)
	{
		if (ch != null && ch.cName != null && !ch.cName.Equals("") && !char.IsUpper(char.Parse(ch.cName.Substring(0, 1))) && !ch.isPet && !ch.isMiniPet && !ch.cName.StartsWith("#"))
		{
			return !ch.cName.StartsWith("$");
		}
		return false;
	}

	static AutoChat()
	{
		listCharInbox = new List<int>();
		inputDelayChatPublic = new string[2] { "Nhập delay chat:", "Mili giây (>=5000ms)" };
		inputDelayChatGlobal = new string[2] { "Nhập delay chat thế giới:", "Mili giây (>=5000ms)" };
		inputSpamChatGlobal = new string[2] { "Nhập số lần spam", "Số lần" };
		LoadSavedData();
	}
}

﻿using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Linq;
using System.Text;
using System.Text.Json;
using System.Text.Json.Serialization;
using System.Threading.Tasks;
using static NRO.AutoMap;

namespace NRO;
public class HistoryManager
{
    private static readonly Queue<string> _logs = new Queue<string>();
    private const int MaxRecords = 100;

    public static void AddLog(string message)
    {
        string timestamp = DateTime.Now.ToString("HH:mm:ss");
        _logs.Enqueue($"[{timestamp}] {message}");

        // Tự động đẩy bản ghi cũ nhất nếu vượt quá giới hạn
        while (_logs.Count > MaxRecords)
        {
            _logs.Dequeue();
        }
    }
    public static string GetSerializedLogs()
    {
        return JsonSerializer.Serialize(_logs.ToList(), AppConfigJsonContext.Default.ListString);
    }
}
[JsonSourceGenerationOptions(WriteIndented = true)]
[JsonSerializable(typeof(AutoMap.MapData))] // Thêm Class mà AutoMap đang dùng vào đây
[JsonSerializable(typeof(List<string>))]
internal partial class AppConfigJsonContext : JsonSerializerContext { }
